```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { VirtuosoGrid } from 'react-virtuoso';
import { convertFileSrc } from '@tauri-apps/api/core';

export interface FileItemData {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    path: string;
    type: 'doc' | 'excel' | 'code' | 'image' | 'pdf' | 'other';
}

const ItemContainer = ({ children, ...props }: any) => (
    <div
        {...props}
        style={{
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            padding: '8px',
            width: '33.33%', // 3 columns
            boxSizing: 'border-box',
        }}
    >
        {children}
    </div>
);

const ListContainer = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, any>((props, ref) => (
    <div {...props} ref={ref} style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', ...props.style }} />
));

export function VirtualFileGrid({ files }: { files: FileItemData[] }) {
    return (
        <VirtuosoGrid
            style={{ height: '100%', width: '100%', minHeight: '400px' }}
            data={files}
            components={{
                List: ListContainer,
                Item: ItemContainer,
            }}
            itemContent={(_index: number, file: FileItemData) => (
                <FilePreviewCard file={file} />
            )}
        />
    );
}

function FilePreviewCard({ file }: { file: FileItemData }) {
    const [error, setError] = React.useState(false);

    const previewUrl = React.useMemo(() => {
        try {
            if (!file.path) return '';
            // Uses Tauri's convertFileSrc to construct custom URI scheme
            const url = convertFileSrc(file.path, 'preview');
            console.log(`DEBUG: Generated preview URL for ${file.name}: ${url}`);
            return url;
        } catch (e) {
            console.error(`DEBUG: Error generating preview URL for ${file.name}`, e);
            return '';
        }
    }, [file.path, file.name]);

    const isHtmlPreview = ['doc', 'excel', 'pdf'].includes(file.type);

    return (
        <div className="flex flex-col border border-cad-border rounded relative bg-cad-elevated overflow-hidden group hover:border-cad-accent transition-colors h-full">
            <div className="h-40 w-full relative bg-[#1a1c23] overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
                {error || !previewUrl ? (
                    <div className="text-cad-text-muted text-xs flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="text-2xl">ðŸ“„</span>
                        <span>No Preview</span>
                    </div>
                ) : isHtmlPreview ? (
                    <iframe
                        src={previewUrl}
                        className="w-full h-full border-none bg-white"
                        sandbox="allow-same-origin"
                        loading="lazy"
                        onError={() => setError(true)}
                        title={`Preview ${file.name}`}
                    />
                ) : (
                    <img
                        src={previewUrl}
                        alt={file.name}
                        loading="lazy"
                        className="w-full h-full object-contain p-2"
                        onError={() => setError(true)}
                    />
                )}
            </div>
            <div className="p-2 border-t border-cad-border flex flex-col gap-1">
                <span className="truncate text-[11px] text-cad-text-primary uppercase font-medium" title={file.name}>
                    {file.name}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-cad-text-muted">
                    {file.type} format
                </span>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}
```

```tsx
import { useRef, useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { ZoomIn, ZoomOut, Maximize2, Crosshair } from "lucide-react";
import { MapLayer } from "@DESIGN/features/map/MapLayer";
import { CoordinatePanel } from "@DESIGN/components/core/CoordinatePanel";
import { useDesignSync } from "@IMPLEMENT/stores/useDesignSync";
import { useCanvasInteraction } from "@IMPLEMENT/hooks/useCanvasInteraction";
import { MapSearchBar } from "@DESIGN/features/map/MapLayerComponents/MapSearchBar";

export function CADCanvas() {
  const [initialCenter] = useState<[number, number]>([21.0285, 105.8542]);

  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const triggerZoomExtend = useDesignSync(s => s.triggerZoomExtend);

  const {
    state,
    drawingMode,
    selectedGroupId,
    activeParentFeatureId,
    dispatchEvent,
    setDrawingMode,
    addDrawingPoint,
    currentDrawingPoints,
    currentDrawingSnapIds
  } = useDesignSync();

  useEffect(() => {
    // Trigger auto-zoom on mount (when entering Design tab)
    triggerZoomExtend();
  }, []); // Only once on mount

  useCanvasInteraction();

  const handleLocationChange = async (lat: number, lng: number, _unused: number, snapId?: string | null) => {
    if (drawingMode === 'none') return;

    if (drawingMode === 'point' || drawingMode === 'image') {
      if (!selectedGroupId) {
        alert("Vui lÃ²ng chá»n má»™t nhÃ³m trÆ°á»›c khi thÃªm Ä‘á»‘i tÆ°á»£ng.");
        setDrawingMode('none');
        return;
      }

      const id = crypto.randomUUID();
      const name = drawingMode === 'point' ? "Äiá»ƒm Kháº£o SÃ¡t Má»›i" : "áº¢nh Hiá»‡n TrÆ°á»ng Má»›i";

      const metadata: any = {
        icon: drawingMode === 'image' ? 'camera' : 'default',
        color: '#3B82F6'
      };

      if (activeParentFeatureId) {
        metadata.parent_feature_id = activeParentFeatureId;
      }

      const group = selectedGroupId ? state?.feature_groups?.[selectedGroupId] : null;
      if (!group) return;

      await dispatchEvent({
        type: 'FeatureCreated',
        payload: {
          id,
          layer_id: group.layer_id,
          group_id: selectedGroupId,
          name,
          geom_type: 'Point',
          coordinates: JSON.stringify([lng, lat]),
          metadata: JSON.stringify({
            ...metadata,
            snapped_object_id: snapId || null
          }),
          properties: JSON.stringify({})
        }
      });

      setDrawingMode('none');
    } else if (drawingMode === 'polyline') {
      addDrawingPoint(lat, lng, snapId);
    }
  };

  const finalizePolyline = async () => {
    if (currentDrawingPoints.length < 2) {
      alert("Cáº§n Ã­t nháº¥t 2 Ä‘iá»ƒm Ä‘á»ƒ táº¡o Ä‘Æ°á»ng.");
      return;
    }

    if (!selectedGroupId) {
      alert("Vui lÃ²ng chá»n má»™t nhÃ³m trÆ°á»›c khi lÆ°u.");
      return;
    }

    const id = crypto.randomUUID();
    const metadata: any = {
      color: '#EF4444'
    };

    if (activeParentFeatureId) {
      metadata.parent_feature_id = activeParentFeatureId;
    }

    const group = selectedGroupId ? state?.feature_groups?.[selectedGroupId] : null;
    if (!group) return;

    console.log("[Polyline] Finalizing with Snap IDs:", currentDrawingSnapIds);
    await dispatchEvent({
      type: 'FeatureCreated',
      payload: {
        id,
        layer_id: group.layer_id,
        group_id: selectedGroupId,
        name: "ÄÆ°á»ng Kháº£o SÃ¡t Má»›i",
        geom_type: 'LineString',
        coordinates: JSON.stringify(currentDrawingPoints),
        metadata: JSON.stringify({
          ...metadata,
          start_node_id: currentDrawingSnapIds[0] || null,
          end_node_id: currentDrawingSnapIds[currentDrawingSnapIds.length - 1] || null
        }),
        properties: JSON.stringify({})
      }
    });

    setDrawingMode('none');
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' && drawingMode === 'polyline') {
        finalizePolyline();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [drawingMode, currentDrawingPoints, selectedGroupId, activeParentFeatureId]);

  const handleLocateMe = () => {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) {
      console.warn("Geolocation is not supported by this browser.");
      return;
    }

    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (position) => {
        const { latitude, longitude } = position.coords;
        console.log("GPS Location:", latitude, longitude);
      },
      (err) => {
        console.error("Geolocation error:", err.message);
      },
      { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 5000 }
    );
  };

  return (
    <div ref={containerRef} className="relative flex-1 overflow-hidden group">
      {/* Map Background - Full layer, no overlay canvas */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 z-0 pointer-events-auto">
        <MapLayer
          center={initialCenter}
          zoom={13}
          onLocationChange={handleLocationChange}
          onFinishDrawing={finalizePolyline}
        />
      </div>

      <MapSearchBar />

      {/* Navigation Controls (Bottom Right) */}
      <div className="absolute bottom-4 right-4 flex flex-col gap-1 z-30 pointer-events-auto">
        <button
          onClick={handleLocateMe}
          title="XÃ¡c Ä‘á»‹nh vá»‹ trÃ­"
          className="p-2 border backdrop-blur-sm transition-all rounded-sm mb-2 bg-cad-surface/80 border-cad-border text-cad-text-secondary hover:text-cyan-400 hover:border-cyan-400 hover:bg-cad-elevated"
        >
          <Crosshair size={14} />
        </button>
        <CADNavButton icon={ZoomIn} />
        <CADNavButton icon={ZoomOut} />
        <CADNavButton icon={Maximize2} onClick={triggerZoomExtend} title="Zoom Extend" />
      </div>

      <CoordinatePanel />
    </div>
  );
}

function CADNavButton({ icon: Icon, onClick, title }: { icon: any, onClick?: () => void, title?: string }) {
  return (
    <button
      onClick={onClick}
      title={title}
      className="p-2 bg-cad-surface/80 border border-cad-border text-cad-text-secondary hover:text-cad-accent hover:bg-cad-elevated backdrop-blur-sm transition-all rounded-sm"
    >
      <Icon size={14} />
    </button>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// Standardized metadata schema
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { X, Save, MapPin, Route, Trash, Camera, Image as ImageIcon, Plus, Loader2, Download, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Star, MessageSquare, Clock, Maximize2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { IconSelector } from '@DESIGN/components/ui/IconSelector';
import type { IconType, VertexMetadata } from '@CONTRACT/types';
import { FeatureState } from '@CONTRACT/types';
import { normalizeMetadataObject, normalizeMetadataWithAI } from '@TOOL/utils/metadataNormalization';
import { DeleteConfirmationModal } from '@DESIGN/components/ui/DeleteConfirmationModal';

interface FeatureEditorProps {
  feature: FeatureState;
  selectedVertexIndex?: number | null;
  onVertexSelect?: (index: number | null) => void;
  onSave: (id: string, updates: any) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  onDelete: (id: string) => void;
}

export const FeatureEditor: React.FC<FeatureEditorProps> = ({
  feature, selectedVertexIndex, onVertexSelect, onSave, onClose, onDelete
}) => {
  const metaObj = normalizeMetadataObject(typeof feature.metadata === 'string' ? JSON.parse(feature.metadata || '{}') : (feature.metadata || {}));

  const [name, setName] = useState(feature.name || '');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState(metaObj.description || '');
  const [imageUrl, setImageUrl] = useState(metaObj.media?.imageUrl || '');
  const [imageUrls, setImageUrls] = useState<string[]>(metaObj.media?.imageUrls || []);
  const [vertexMetadata, setVertexMetadata] = useState<Record<number, VertexMetadata>>(metaObj.vertexMetadata || {});
  const [color, setColor] = useState(metaObj.color || '#3b82f6');
  const [size, setSize] = useState(metaObj.size || 32);
  const [icon, setIcon] = useState<IconType>((metaObj.icon as IconType) || 'default');

  const [isCameraOpen, setIsCameraOpen] = useState(false);
  const [cameraTarget, setCameraTarget] = useState<'main' | number>('main');
  const [stream, setStream] = useState<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState(new Date().toLocaleString('vi-VN'));
  const [isCapturing, setIsCapturing] = useState(false);
  const [isDeleteModalOpen, setIsDeleteModalOpen] = useState(false);

  const [viewingImageIndex, setViewingImageIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const [deleteModalConfig, setDeleteModalConfig] = useState<{ isOpen: boolean; type: 'feature' | 'image' | null; targetIdx: number | null }>({
    isOpen: false,
    type: null,
    targetIdx: null
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const raw = typeof feature.metadata === 'string' ? JSON.parse(feature.metadata || '{}') : (feature.metadata || {});
    const meta = normalizeMetadataObject(raw);

    setName(feature.name || '');
    setDescription(meta.description || '');
    setImageUrl(meta.media?.imageUrl || '');
    setImageUrls(meta.media?.imageUrls || []);
    setVertexMetadata(meta.vertexMetadata || {});
    setColor(meta.color || '#3b82f6');
    setSize(meta.size || (feature.geom_type === 'Point' ? 32 : 4));
    setIcon((meta.icon as IconType) || 'default');
  }, [feature?.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => setCurrentTime(new Date().toLocaleString('vi-VN')), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isCameraOpen && stream && videoRef.current) {
      videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
    }
  }, [isCameraOpen, stream]);

  const startCamera = (target: 'main' | number) => {
    setCameraTarget(target);
    navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
      video: { facingMode: 'environment', width: { ideal: 1920 }, height: { ideal: 1080 } },
      audio: false
    }).then(s => {
      setStream(s);
      setIsCameraOpen(true);
    }).catch(() => {
      setIsCameraOpen(true);
    });
  };

  const stopCamera = () => {
    if (stream) stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
    setStream(null);
    setIsCameraOpen(false);
    setIsCapturing(false);
  };

  const applyWatermark = (source: HTMLVideoElement | HTMLImageElement) => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;

    setIsCapturing(true);
    const isVideo = source instanceof HTMLVideoElement;
    canvas.width = isVideo ? (source as HTMLVideoElement).videoWidth : (source as HTMLImageElement).naturalWidth;
    canvas.height = isVideo ? (source as HTMLVideoElement).videoHeight : (source as HTMLImageElement).naturalHeight;

    if (canvas.width === 0) { canvas.width = 1280; canvas.height = 720; }

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (ctx) {
      ctx.drawImage(source, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      const timestamp = new Date().toLocaleString('vi-VN');

      let targetCoords: [number, number] | null = null;
      let coords: [number, number][] = [];
      try {
        coords = JSON.parse(feature.coordinates);
      } catch (e) { }

      if (cameraTarget === 'main') {
        const first = Array.isArray(coords[0]) ? coords[0] : coords;
        targetCoords = (first as any) || null;
      } else {
        targetCoords = coords[cameraTarget as number];
      }

      const fontSize = Math.max(18, Math.floor(canvas.height / 35));
      ctx.font = `bold ${fontSize}px sans-serif`;
      const padding = fontSize;
      const lineHeight = fontSize * 1.5;
      const lines = [
        targetCoords ? `ðŸ“ Tá»a Ä‘á»™: ${targetCoords[0].toFixed(6)}, ${targetCoords[1].toFixed(6)}` : null,
        `â° Thá»i gian: ${timestamp}`,
        `ðŸ¢ Äá»‘i tÆ°á»£ng: ${name || 'N/A'}`
      ].filter(Boolean);

      const boxWidth = Math.min(canvas.width * 0.8, 600);
      const boxHeight = lines.length * lineHeight + padding;
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, canvas.height - boxHeight, boxWidth, boxHeight);
      ctx.fillStyle = "white";
      let currentY = canvas.height - padding;
      lines.reverse().forEach(line => { if (line) { ctx.fillText(line, padding, currentY); currentY -= lineHeight; } });

      const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.85);

      if (cameraTarget === 'main') {
        setImageUrls(prev => [...prev, dataUrl]);
        if (!imageUrl) setImageUrl(dataUrl);
      } else {
        const idx = cameraTarget as number;
        setVertexMetadata(prev => {
          const currentMeta = prev[idx] || {};
          const currentImages = currentMeta.imageUrls || (currentMeta.imageUrl ? [currentMeta.imageUrl] : []);
          return { ...prev, [idx]: { ...currentMeta, imageUrls: [...currentImages, dataUrl], imageUrl: dataUrl } };
        });
      }
      stopCamera();
    }
  };

  const handleFileSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (event) => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => applyWatermark(img);
      img.src = event.target?.result as string;
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const downloadImage = (url: string) => {
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `CAD_${name.replace(/\s+/g, '_')}_${Date.now()}.jpg`;
    link.click();
  };

  const removeVertexImage = (vIdx: number, imgIdx: number) => {
    setVertexMetadata(prev => {
      const meta = { ...prev[vIdx] };
      const imgs = [...(meta.imageUrls || [])];
      imgs.splice(imgIdx, 1);
      return { ...prev, [vIdx]: { ...meta, imageUrls: imgs, imageUrl: imgs.length > 0 ? imgs[0] : undefined } };
    });
  };

  const handleDelete = () => {
    setIsDeleteModalOpen(true);
  };

  const confirmDelete = () => {
    setIsDeleteModalOpen(false);
    onDelete(feature.id);
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    const metadata = {
      description,
      imageUrl,
      imageUrls,
      vertexMetadata,
      color,
      size,
      icon
    };

    const normalizedMeta = await normalizeMetadataWithAI(metadata, name);
    onSave(feature.id, {
      name,
      metadata: JSON.stringify(normalizedMeta)
    });
  };

  let coords: [number, number][] = [];
  try {
    coords = JSON.parse(feature.coordinates);
    if (!Array.isArray(coords[0])) {
      coords = [coords as any]; // Single point array wrap to make logic simple
    }
  } catch (e) { }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-white w-full border-l border-gray-100 overflow-hidden">

      {/* Lightbox / SlideShow */}
      {viewingImageIndex !== null && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[6000] bg-slate-950/95 backdrop-blur-md flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-300" onClick={() => setViewingImageIndex(null)}>
          <div className="absolute top-6 right-6 flex gap-3">
            <button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); downloadImage(imageUrls[viewingImageIndex]); }} className="p-3 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white rounded-full border border-white/10"><Download className="w-5 h-5" /></button>
            <button onClick={() => setViewingImageIndex(null)} className="p-3 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white rounded-full border border-white/10"><X className="w-5 h-5" /></button>
          </div>
          <div className="relative w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-4">
            {imageUrls.length > 1 && (
              <button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setViewingImageIndex(p => p! > 0 ? p! - 1 : imageUrls.length - 1); }} className="p-4 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-white rounded-full"><ChevronLeft className="w-8 h-8" /></button>
            )}
            <img src={imageUrls[viewingImageIndex]} className="max-w-full max-h-[75vh] object-contain rounded-xl shadow-2xl border border-white/10" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} />
            {imageUrls.length > 1 && (
              <button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setViewingImageIndex(p => p! < imageUrls.length - 1 ? p! + 1 : 0); }} className="p-4 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-white rounded-full"><ChevronRight className="w-8 h-8" /></button>

      )}

      <div className="p-4 border-b bg-gray-50 flex justify-between items-center shrink-0">

          {feature.geom_type === 'LineString' ? <Route className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" /> : <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />}
          Cáº¥u hÃ¬nh {feature.geom_type === 'LineString' ? 'Tuyáº¿n' : 'Äiá»ƒm'}
        </h2>
        <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1 hover:bg-gray-200 rounded-full transition-all"><X className="w-5 h-5" /></button>
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Terminal, Sparkles, Send } from "lucide-react";

export function CommandPrompt() {
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");

  const handleCommand = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && input.trim()) {
      console.log("Execute command:", input);
      setInput("");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="absolute bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-[600px] pointer-events-auto bg-cad-surface/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-cad-border rounded shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col group/cmd">
      <div className="bg-cad-bg/50 px-3 py-1 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-cad-border/50">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Terminal size={10} className="text-cad-accent" />
          <span className="text-[9px] font-black tracking-widest text-cad-text-muted uppercase">Command Console</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[8px] text-[#A855F7] hover:text-[#C084FC] transition-colors font-bold uppercase"><Sparkles size={10} /> AI Command</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="p-2 flex flex-col gap-1 max-h-[80px] overflow-y-auto text-[9px] font-mono text-cad-text-muted scrollbar-hide">
        <div className="opacity-50 tracking-tighter lowercase">sys: v0.4.2 stable build</div>
        <div className="text-cad-accent/40">drawing: viewport normalized (0,0,1024,1024)</div>
        <div className="flex gap-2"><span>cmd:</span> <span className="text-white">_LINE</span></div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center bg-black/40 border-t border-cad-border/30 p-1">
        <span className="text-cad-accent font-black mx-2 text-[12px] font-mono select-none">_</span>
        <input 
          type="text" 
          value={input}
          onChange={e => setInput(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={handleCommand}
          placeholder="ENTER COMMAND OR ASK AI ASSISTANT..."
          className="flex-1 bg-transparent text-white font-mono text-[10px] outline-none placeholder:text-cad-text-muted/30 uppercase tracking-tight"
        />
        <button onClick={() => setInput("")} className="p-1.5 text-cad-text-muted hover:text-cad-accent transition-colors"><Send size={12}/></button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useState, useMemo, useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Database, PlusCircle, Map as MapIcon, FolderPlus, Trash2, MoreVertical, Maximize2, Type, Palette, Camera, RefreshCw, FileUp, Search } from "lucide-react";
import { Virtuoso } from "react-virtuoso";
import { open } from "@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog";
import { TreeItem } from "@DESIGN/components/core/CADPanels/TreeItem";
import { FeatureItem } from "@DESIGN/components/core/CADPanels/FeatureItem";
import { useDesignSync, EMPTY_OBJ, type DesignEventType } from "@IMPLEMENT/stores/useDesignSync";
import { importFromExcel, importFromKML, getExcelHeaders, type ImportMapping } from "@IMPLEMENT/services/importService";
import { Intersection } from "@DESIGN/components/icons/MapIcons";
import { ThemeModal } from "@DESIGN/components/ui/ThemeModal";
import { MappingDialog } from "@DESIGN/components/core/CADPanels/MappingDialog";
import { DeleteConfirmationModal } from "@DESIGN/components/ui/DeleteConfirmationModal";
import { getFeatureDisplayInfo, getParsedMetadata, calculateFeatureNumbers, isMatchSearch } from "@TOOL/utils/featureUtils";
import { cn } from "@TOOL/utils/cn";

export function DrawingExplorer() {
  const regionsMap = useDesignSync(s => s.state?.regions || (EMPTY_OBJ as Record<string, any>));
  const layersMap = useDesignSync(s => s.state?.layers || (EMPTY_OBJ as Record<string, any>));
  const groupsMap = useDesignSync(s => s.state?.feature_groups || (EMPTY_OBJ as Record<string, any>));
  const featuresMap = useDesignSync(s => s.state?.features || (EMPTY_OBJ as Record<string, any>));

  const selectedFeatureId = useDesignSync(s => s.selectedFeatureId);
  const selectedGroupId = useDesignSync(s => s.selectedGroupId);
  const selectFeature = useDesignSync(s => s.selectFeature);
  const setSelectedGroup = useDesignSync(s => s.setSelectedGroup);
  const dispatchEvent = useDesignSync(s => s.dispatchEvent);
  const dispatchEvents = useDesignSync(s => s.dispatchEvents);
  const zoomTo = useDesignSync(s => s.zoomTo);
  const selectionSet = useDesignSync(s => s.selectionSet);
  const toggleSelection = useDesignSync(s => s.toggleSelection);
  const selectAll = useDesignSync(s => s.selectAll);
  const clearSelection = useDesignSync(s => s.clearSelection);
  const deleteSelectedFeatures = useDesignSync(s => s.deleteSelectedFeatures);
  const hoverId = useDesignSync(s => s.hoverId);

  const showNotes = useDesignSync(s => s.showNotes);
  const setShowNotes = useDesignSync(s => s.setShowNotes);
  const showQr = useDesignSync(s => s.showQr);
  const setShowQr = useDesignSync(s => s.setShowQr);
  const showCode = useDesignSync(s => s.showCode);
  const setShowCode = useDesignSync(s => s.setShowCode);

  const virtuosoRef = useRef<any>(null);

  // --- Shadow Refs for D&D Stability (V8) ---
  const featuresRef = useRef(featuresMap);
  const groupsRef = useRef(groupsMap);
  const regionsRef = useRef(regionsMap);
  const dispatchRef = useRef(dispatchEvent);
  const dispatchEventsRef = useRef(dispatchEvents);
  const selectionRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const projectId = useDesignSync(s => s.projectId);
  const projectPath = useDesignSync(s => s.projectPath);
  const isLoading = useDesignSync(s => s.isLoading);
  const error = useDesignSync(s => s.error);
  const initialize = useDesignSync(s => s.initialize);

  // V14: Virtual Drag State (Native Shield Bypass)
  const [isVirtualDragging, setIsVirtualDragging] = useState(false);
  const virtualDragRef = useRef<{
    type: string;
    ids: string[];
    startX: number;
    startY: number;
    lastTarget: HTMLElement | null;
  } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => { featuresRef.current = featuresMap; }, [featuresMap]);
  useEffect(() => { groupsRef.current = groupsMap; }, [groupsMap]);
  useEffect(() => { regionsRef.current = regionsMap; }, [regionsMap]);
  useEffect(() => { dispatchRef.current = dispatchEvent; }, [dispatchEvent]);
  useEffect(() => { dispatchEventsRef.current = dispatchEvents; }, [dispatchEvents]);
  useEffect(() => { selectionRef.current = selectionSet; }, [selectionSet]);
  const hasAutoExpanded = useRef(false);

  // V9.0: NO STATE FOR DROP TARGET (Prevents Cancelling Drag)
  // const [dropTargetId, setDropTargetId] = useState<string | null>(null); // REMOVED


  const designs = useMemo(() => Object.values(featuresMap), [featuresMap]);
  const featureNumbers = useMemo(() => calculateFeatureNumbers(designs, featuresMap), [designs, featuresMap]);

  // V14: Persisted Expanded State
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(`drawing-explorer-expanded-${projectId}`);
      return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : {};
    } catch {
      return {};
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (projectId) {
      localStorage.setItem(`drawing-explorer-expanded-${projectId}`, JSON.stringify(expanded));
    }
  }, [expanded, projectId]);
  const [contextMenu, setContextMenu] = useState<{
    x: number;
    y: number;
    type: 'region' | 'group' | 'layer' | 'feature';
    id: string;
    data: any;
  } | null>(null);

  // Close menu on click outside
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClick = () => setContextMenu(null);
    window.addEventListener('click', handleClick);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('click', handleClick);
  }, []);

  const [deleteModal, setDeleteModal] = useState<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    type: 'region' | 'group' | 'layer' | 'feature' | null;
    id: string;
    name: string;
  }>({
    isOpen: false,
    type: null,
    id: '',
    name: ''
  });

  // Close menu on click outside
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClick = () => setContextMenu(null);
    window.addEventListener('click', handleClick);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('click', handleClick);
  }, []);

  const handleContextMenu = (e: React.MouseEvent, type: 'region' | 'group' | 'layer' | 'feature', id: string, data: any) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setContextMenu({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, type, id, data });
  };

  // V14: Execute Move logic (Universal Transition Engine)
  const handleExecuteMove = useCallback((currentDrag: { type: string; ids: string[] }, targetType: 'region' | 'group' | 'feature', targetId: string) => {
    if (!currentDrag || currentDrag.ids.includes(targetId)) return;

    const fMap = featuresRef.current;
    const gMap = groupsRef.current;
    const rMap = regionsRef.current;

    const events: DesignEventType[] = [];
    const timestamp = Date.now();

    currentDrag.ids.forEach((id, index) => {
      const feature = fMap[id];
      const group = gMap[id];
      if (!feature && !group) return;

      if (currentDrag.type === 'feature' && feature) {
        if (targetType === 'region') {
          // Detach from current group -> becomes independent in this region
          const region = rMap[targetId];
          const targetLayerId = region?.layers?.[0]?.id || region?.layer_id;
          if (targetLayerId) {
            events.push({
              type: 'FeatureUpdated',
              payload: { id, layer_id: targetLayerId, group_id: "" } // "" means null in backend convention
            });
          }
        } else if (targetType === 'group') {
          const targetGroup = gMap[targetId];
          if (targetGroup) {
            events.push({
              type: 'FeatureUpdated',
              payload: { id, layer_id: targetGroup.layer_id, group_id: targetId }
            });
          }
        } else if (targetType === 'feature' && id !== targetId) {
          const targetFeature = fMap[targetId];
          if (targetFeature) {
            const targetOrder = getParsedMetadata(targetFeature).display_order || 0;
            const newOrder = Number(targetOrder) + 0.001 * (index + 1);
            events.push({
              type: 'FeatureUpdated',
              payload: {
                id,
                layer_id: targetFeature.layer_id,
                group_id: targetFeature.group_id,
                metadata: JSON.stringify({ ...getParsedMetadata(feature), display_order: newOrder })
              }
            });
          }
        }
      } else if (currentDrag.type === 'group' && group && id !== targetId) {
        const currentMeta = getParsedMetadata(group);
        const newOrder = timestamp + (index * 0.001);

        if (targetType === 'region') {
          const region = rMap[targetId];
          const targetLayerId = region?.layers?.[0]?.id || region?.layer_id;
          if (targetLayerId) {
            events.push({
              type: 'FeatureGroupUpdated',
              payload: { id, name: group.name, is_visible: group.is_visible, metadata: JSON.stringify({ ...currentMeta, parent_id: null, layer_id: targetLayerId, display_order: newOrder }) }
            } as any);
          }
        } else if (targetType === 'group') {
          const targetGroup = gMap[targetId];
          if (targetGroup) {
            events.push({
              type: 'FeatureGroupUpdated',
              payload: { id, name: group.name, is_visible: group.is_visible, metadata: JSON.stringify({ ...currentMeta, parent_id: targetId, layer_id: targetGroup.layer_id, display_order: newOrder }) }
            } as any);
          }
        }
      }
    });

    if (events.length > 0) {
      dispatchEventsRef.current(events);
      clearSelection();
    }
  }, []);

  // V14: makeDropHandlers now returns EMPTY objects to prevent React from handling Over/Drop
  const makeDropHandlers = useCallback((_targetType: string, _targetId: string) => ({
    // We handle everything natively in the Overlord Layer
  }), []);

  // V14: Global Mouse Listeners (The "Engine" Loop)
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleGlobalMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const ctx = virtualDragRef.current;
      if (!ctx) return;

      if (!isVirtualDragging) {
        const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(e.clientX - ctx.startX, 2) + Math.pow(e.clientY - ctx.startY, 2));
        if (dist > 5) {
          setIsVirtualDragging(true);
          document.body.style.cursor = "grabbing";
          document.body.style.userSelect = "none";
        }
        return;
      }

      const el = document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY) as HTMLElement;
      const target = el?.closest('[data-drag-id]') as HTMLElement;

      if (target && target !== ctx.lastTarget) {
        if (ctx.lastTarget) {
          ctx.lastTarget.style.outline = "";
          ctx.lastTarget.style.background = "";
        }
        const tId = target.getAttribute('data-drag-id');
        if (tId && !draggingIdsRef.current.includes(tId)) {
          target.style.outline = "2px solid #10B981";
          target.style.background = "rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1)";
          ctx.lastTarget = target;
        }
      } else if (!target && ctx.lastTarget) {
        ctx.lastTarget.style.outline = "";
        ctx.lastTarget.style.background = "";
        ctx.lastTarget = null;
      }
    };

    const handleGlobalMouseUp = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const ctx = virtualDragRef.current;
      if (!ctx) return;

      if (isVirtualDragging) {
        const el = document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        const target = el?.closest('[data-drag-id]');
        if (target) {
          const tId = target.getAttribute('data-drag-id');
          const tType = target.getAttribute('data-drag-type') as any;
          if (tId && tType) {
            handleExecuteMove(ctx, tType, tId);
          }
        }
      }

      if (ctx.lastTarget) {
        ctx.lastTarget.style.outline = "";
        ctx.lastTarget.style.background = "";
      }
      virtualDragRef.current = null;
      setIsVirtualDragging(false);
      document.body.style.cursor = "";
      document.body.style.userSelect = "";
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleGlobalMouseMove, true);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleGlobalMouseUp, true);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleGlobalMouseMove, true);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleGlobalMouseUp, true);
    };
  }, [isVirtualDragging, handleExecuteMove]);

  // V14: Initiate Virtual Drag
  const handleVirtualDragStart = (e: React.MouseEvent, type: string, id: string) => {
    // Only left click
    if (e.button !== 0) return;

    const ids = selectionSet.has(id) ? Array.from(selectionSet) : [id];
    virtualDragRef.current = {
      type,
      ids,
      startX: e.clientX,
      startY: e.clientY,
      lastTarget: null
    };
  };

  // Keep a ref to dragging IDs for easier access in global listener
  const draggingIdsRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
  useEffect(() => {
    draggingIdsRef.current = virtualDragRef.current?.ids || [];
  }, [isVirtualDragging]);

  const [treeSearchQuery, setTreeSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [reverseOrder, setReverseOrder] = useState(false);
  const [sortField, setSortField] = useState<'name' | 'stt'>('name');

  // Additional UI states
  const [themeGroupId, setThemeGroupId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [mappingData, setMappingData] = useState<{
    headers: string[];
    filename: string;
    groupId: string;
    filePath: string;
  } | null>(null);

  // Auto-expand to selected feature
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedFeatureId) {
      const feature = featuresMap[selectedFeatureId];
      if (feature) {
        // Expand feature's group and its entire parent chain
        const expandChain: Record<string, boolean> = {};

        // V20: Expand parent features if this is a nested feature
        const meta = getParsedMetadata(feature);
        let currentParentId = meta.parent_feature_id;
        while (currentParentId) {
          expandChain[`feature-${currentParentId}`] = true;
          const parentFeature = featuresMap[currentParentId];
          currentParentId = parentFeature ? getParsedMetadata(parentFeature).parent_feature_id : null;
        }

        if (feature.group_id) {
          expandChain[feature.group_id] = true;
          // Also highlight the group
          if (selectedGroupId !== feature.group_id) {
            setSelectedGroup(feature.group_id);
          }

          let current = groupsMap[feature.group_id];
          while (current?.parent_id) {
            expandChain[current.parent_id] = true;
            current = groupsMap[current.parent_id];
          }
          if (current) {
            const layer = layersMap[current.layer_id];
            if (layer) {
              const region = Object.values(regionsMap).find(r => r.id === layer.region_id);
              if (region) expandChain[region.id] = true;
            }
          }
        } else {
          // Independent feature in a region
          const layer = layersMap[feature.layer_id];
          if (layer) {
            const region = Object.values(regionsMap).find(r => r.id === layer.region_id);
            if (region) expandChain[region.id] = true;
          }
        }

        setExpanded(prev => {
          const next = { ...prev };
          let changed = false;
          Object.keys(expandChain).forEach(id => {
            if (!next[id]) {
              next[id] = true;
              changed = true;
            }
          });
          return changed ? next : prev;
        });
      }
    }
  }, [selectedFeatureId, featuresMap, groupsMap, layersMap, regionsMap, selectedGroupId, setSelectedGroup]);

  // Auto-expand selected group and its parent chain (e.g., after upload)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedGroupId && !selectedFeatureId) {
      const expandChain: Record<string, boolean> = { [selectedGroupId]: true };
      let current = groupsMap[selectedGroupId];
      while (current?.parent_id) {
        expandChain[current.parent_id] = true;
        current = groupsMap[current.parent_id];
      }
      if (current) {
        const layer = layersMap[current.layer_id];
        if (layer) {
          const region = Object.values(regionsMap).find(r => r.id === layer.region_id);
          if (region) expandChain[region.id] = true;
        }
      }
      setExpanded(prev => {
        const next = { ...prev };
        let changed = false;
        Object.keys(expandChain).forEach(id => {
          if (!next[id]) {
            next[id] = true;
            changed = true;
          }
        });
        return changed ? next : prev;
      });
    }
  }, [selectedGroupId, selectedFeatureId, groupsMap, layersMap, regionsMap]);

  const state = useDesignSync(s => s.state);

  const toggleExpand = (id: string) => {
    setExpanded(prev => ({ ...prev, [id]: !prev[id] }));
  };

  const findPrimaryIntersectionFeature = useCallback((groupId: string) => {
    const group = groupsMap[groupId];
    if (!group) return null;
    const featuresInGroup = Object.values(featuresMap).filter((f: any) => f.group_id === groupId);
    if (featuresInGroup.length === 0) return null;

    for (const f of featuresInGroup) {
      const meta = getParsedMetadata(f);
      if (meta.parent_feature_id) continue;
      const info = getFeatureDisplayInfo(f, group.type, group.name);
      if (info.isIntersection) return f.id;
    }

    const rootFeature = featuresInGroup.find((f: any) => !getParsedMetadata(f).parent_feature_id);
    return rootFeature?.id || featuresInGroup[0].id;
  }, [featuresMap, groupsMap]);

  // Filtering Logic
  const matchesSearch = useCallback((item: any) => {
    if (!treeSearchQuery || !treeSearchQuery.trim()) return true;
    return isMatchSearch(item, treeSearchQuery, featureNumbers);
  }, [treeSearchQuery, featureNumbers]);



  // Helper to get all feature IDs under a specific node (recursively)
  const getAllFeatureIdsUnder = useCallback((type: 'region' | 'group', id: string): string[] => {
    const featureIds: string[] = [];

    const collectFromGroup = (groupId: string) => {
      // Features directly in this group
      const directFeatures = Object.values(featuresMap).filter((f: any) => f.group_id === groupId);
      directFeatures.forEach(f => featureIds.push(f.id));

      // Subgroups
      const subGroups = Object.values(groupsMap).filter((g: any) => g.parent_id === groupId);
      subGroups.forEach(sg => collectFromGroup(sg.id));
    };

    if (type === 'group') {
      collectFromGroup(id);
    } else if (type === 'region') {
      const regionLayers = Object.values(layersMap).filter((l: any) => l.region_id === id);
      regionLayers.forEach(layer => {
        const rootGroups = Object.values(groupsMap).filter((g: any) => g.layer_id === layer.id && !g.parent_id);
        rootGroups.forEach(rg => collectFromGroup(rg.id));
      });
    }

    return featureIds;
  }, [featuresMap, groupsMap, layersMap]);


  const handleToggleCheck = (type: 'region' | 'group' | 'feature', id: string) => {
    if (type === 'feature') {
      toggleSelection(id);
    } else {
      const descendantIds = getAllFeatureIdsUnder(type, id);
      const currentlyAllSelected = descendantIds.length > 0 && descendantIds.every(fid => selectionSet.has(fid));

      if (!currentlyAllSelected) {
        selectAll(descendantIds);
      } else {
        const newSet = new Set(selectionSet);
        descendantIds.forEach(did => newSet.delete(did));
        clearSelection();
        selectAll(Array.from(newSet));
      }
    }
  };


  const isPartiallyChecked = (type: 'region' | 'group', id: string) => {
    const ids = getAllFeatureIdsUnder(type, id);
    if (ids.length === 0) return false;
    const selectedCount = ids.filter(fid => selectionSet.has(fid)).length;
    return selectedCount > 0 && selectedCount < ids.length;
  };

  const isAllChecked = (type: 'region' | 'group', id: string) => {
    const ids = getAllFeatureIdsUnder(type, id);
    if (ids.length === 0) return false;
    return ids.every(fid => selectionSet.has(fid));
  };


  const handleRename = (type: 'region' | 'group' | 'layer' | 'feature', id: string, newName: string, currentData: any) => {
    if (!newName.trim() || newName === currentData.name) return;
    if (type === 'region') {
      dispatchEvent({ type: 'RegionUpdated', payload: { id, name: newName, description: currentData.description } });
    } else if (type === 'layer') {
      dispatchEvent({ type: 'LayerUpdated', payload: { id, name: newName, is_visible: currentData.is_visible } });
    } else if (type === 'group') {
      dispatchEvent({ type: 'FeatureGroupUpdated', payload: { id, name: newName, is_visible: currentData.is_visible } });
    }
  };

  const handleToggleVisible = (type: 'region' | 'layer' | 'group' | 'feature', id: string, currentData: any, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const events: DesignEventType[] = [];

    if (type === 'region') {
      const layers = Object.values(layersMap).filter(l => l.region_id === id);
      const targetLayer = layers[0];
      if (targetLayer) {
        const nv = !targetLayer.is_visible;
        events.push({ type: 'LayerUpdated', payload: { id: targetLayer.id, name: targetLayer.name, is_visible: nv } });

        // Recursive for all groups in this region
        const rGroups = Object.values(groupsMap).filter(g => g.layer_id === targetLayer.id);
        rGroups.forEach(g => {
          events.push({ type: 'FeatureGroupUpdated', payload: { id: g.id, name: g.name, is_visible: nv } });
        });

        // Recursive for all features in this region
        const rFeatures = Object.values(featuresMap).filter(f => f.layer_id === targetLayer.id);
        rFeatures.forEach(cf => {
          const meta = getParsedMetadata(cf);
          events.push({ type: 'FeatureUpdated', payload: { id: cf.id, metadata: JSON.stringify({ ...meta, is_visible: nv }) } });
        });
      }
    } else if (type === 'layer') {
      const nv = !currentData.is_visible;
      events.push({ type: 'LayerUpdated', payload: { id, name: currentData.name, is_visible: nv } });
    } else if (type === 'group') {
      const nv = currentData.is_visible === false ? true : false;
      events.push({ type: 'FeatureGroupUpdated', payload: { id, name: currentData.name, is_visible: nv } });

      const collectDescendants = (parentId: string) => {
        const childGroups = Object.values(groupsMap).filter((g: any) => g.parent_id === parentId);
        childGroups.forEach(cg => {
          events.push({ type: 'FeatureGroupUpdated', payload: { id: cg.id, name: cg.name, is_visible: nv } });
          collectDescendants(cg.id);
        });

        const childFeatures = Object.values(featuresMap).filter((f: any) => f.group_id === parentId);
        childFeatures.forEach(cf => {
          const meta = getParsedMetadata(cf);
          events.push({ type: 'FeatureUpdated', payload: { id: cf.id, metadata: JSON.stringify({ ...meta, is_visible: nv }) } });
        });
      };
      collectDescendants(id);
    } else if (type === 'feature') {
      const meta = getParsedMetadata(currentData);
      const nv = meta.is_visible === false ? true : false;
      events.push({ type: 'FeatureUpdated', payload: { id, metadata: JSON.stringify({ ...meta, is_visible: nv }) } });

      const updateRecursive = (parentId: string) => {
        const childFeatures = Object.values(featuresMap).filter((f: any) => getParsedMetadata(f).parent_feature_id === parentId);
        childFeatures.forEach(f => {
          const m = getParsedMetadata(f);
          events.push({ type: 'FeatureUpdated', payload: { id: f.id, metadata: JSON.stringify({ ...m, is_visible: nv }) } });
          updateRecursive(f.id);
        });
      };
      updateRecursive(id);
    }

    if (events.length > 0) {
      dispatchEvents(events);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = (type: 'region' | 'group' | 'layer' | 'feature', id: string, name: string) => {
    setDeleteModal({ isOpen: true, type, id, name });
  };

  const confirmDelete = async () => {
    const { type, id } = deleteModal;
    if (!type) return;

    if (type === 'region') {
      dispatchEvent({ type: 'RegionDeleted', payload: { id } });
    } else if (type === 'layer') {
      dispatchEvent({ type: 'LayerDeleted', payload: { id } });
    } else if (type === 'group') {
      dispatchEvent({ type: 'FeatureGroupDeleted', payload: { id } });
    } else if (type === 'feature') {
      if (id === 'selected') {
        deleteSelectedFeatures();
      } else {
        dispatchEvent({ type: 'FeatureDeleted', payload: { id } });
      }
    }
  };



  // 1. Convert maps to lists for processing
  const layers = useMemo(() => Object.values(layersMap), [layersMap]);
  const groups = useMemo(() => Object.values(groupsMap), [groupsMap]);
  const features = useMemo(() => Object.values(featuresMap), [featuresMap]);

  // 2. Build mapping structures
  const {
    regionGroupsMap,
    groupFeaturesMap,
    regionIndependentFeaturesMap,
    featureChildrenMap,
    groupParentMap
  } = useMemo(() => {
    const lRegionMap: Record<string, string> = {};
    const rGroupsMap: Record<string, any[]> = {};
    const gFeaturesMap: Record<string, any[]> = {};
    const rIndependentFeaturesMap: Record<string, any[]> = {};
    const fChildrenMap: Record<string, any[]> = {};
    const gParentMap: Record<string, any[]> = {};
    const fByGroupMap: Record<string, any[]> = {}; // Kept locally if needed, but not used globally anymore

    layers.forEach(l => {
      lRegionMap[l.id] = l.region_id;
    });

    const compareItems = (a: any, b: any) => {
      // Groups use metadata.display_order directly (calculated during drop)
      // Features use featureNumbers (which includes display_order + hierarchical stt)
      const aStt = featureNumbers[a.id] || getParsedMetadata(a).display_order;
      const bStt = featureNumbers[b.id] || getParsedMetadata(b).display_order;

      if (sortField === 'stt' && (aStt !== undefined || bStt !== undefined)) {
        if (aStt === undefined) return 1;
        if (bStt === undefined) return -1;
        if (aStt === bStt) return 0;

        // Use a faster numeric comparison if possible, or memoize split parts
        const sA = aStt.toString();
        const sB = bStt.toString();

        return sA.localeCompare(sB, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' });
      }

      const nameA = a.name || '';
      const nameB = b.name || '';

      if (nameA !== nameB) {
        return nameA.localeCompare(nameB, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' });
      }

      return a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
    };

    const sortedGroups = [...groups].sort(compareItems);
    sortedGroups.forEach(g => {
      const regionId = lRegionMap[g.layer_id];
      if (regionId && !g.parent_id) {
        if (!rGroupsMap[regionId]) rGroupsMap[regionId] = [];
        rGroupsMap[regionId].push(g);
      }

      const parentId = g.parent_id || 'root';
      if (!gParentMap[parentId]) gParentMap[parentId] = [];
      gParentMap[parentId].push(g);
    });

    const sortedFeatures = [...features].sort(compareItems);
    sortedFeatures.forEach(f => {
      const meta = getParsedMetadata(f);
      const parentFeatureId = meta.parent_feature_id;

      // Populate fByGroupMap locally if needed (currently not used)
      if (f.group_id) {
        if (!fByGroupMap[f.group_id]) fByGroupMap[f.group_id] = [];
        fByGroupMap[f.group_id].push(f);
      }

      if (parentFeatureId) {
        if (!fChildrenMap[parentFeatureId]) fChildrenMap[parentFeatureId] = [];
        fChildrenMap[parentFeatureId].push(f);
      } else if (f.group_id && groupsMap[f.group_id]) {
        if (!gFeaturesMap[f.group_id]) gFeaturesMap[f.group_id] = [];
        gFeaturesMap[f.group_id].push(f);
      } else {
        const regionId = lRegionMap[f.layer_id];
        if (regionId) {
          if (!rIndependentFeaturesMap[regionId]) rIndependentFeaturesMap[regionId] = [];
          rIndependentFeaturesMap[regionId].push(f);
        }
      }
    });

    return {
      regionGroupsMap: rGroupsMap,
      groupFeaturesMap: gFeaturesMap,
      regionIndependentFeaturesMap: rIndependentFeaturesMap,
      featureChildrenMap: fChildrenMap,
      groupParentMap: gParentMap
    };
  }, [layers, groups, features, sortField, featureNumbers, groupsMap]);

  // V14: Auto-expand first 2 layers on initial load
  useEffect(() => {
    const regionIds = Object.keys(regionsMap);
    if (!hasAutoExpanded.current && regionIds.length > 0 && !isLoading && !error) {
      setExpanded(_prev => {
        // V18: Only prioritize expansion up to Level 2 (Folders)
        const next: Record<string, boolean> = {};
        regionIds.forEach(rId => {
          next[rId] = true; // Expand Project (Báº­c 1)
          const topGroups = regionGroupsMap[rId] || [];
          topGroups.forEach((g: any) => {
            next[g.id] = true; // Expand Folder (Báº­c 2)
          });
        });
        return next;
      });
      hasAutoExpanded.current = true;
    } else if (regionIds.length === 0) {
      hasAutoExpanded.current = false;
    }
  }, [regionsMap, regionGroupsMap, isLoading, error]);

  // 3. Recursive Visibility Map - Pre-calculate which nodes should be visible
  const groupVisibilityMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map: Record<string, boolean> = {};
    if (!treeSearchQuery?.trim() && !filterType) return null; // Use null to signify "everything visible"

    const checkGroup = (groupId: string): boolean => {
      if (map[groupId] !== undefined) return map[groupId];

      const group = groupsMap[groupId];
      if (!group) return false;

      // Check if group matches filter
      const selfMatches = matchesSearch(group) && (
        !filterType ||
        (filterType === 'FOLDER' && (group.group_type === 'default' || !group.group_type)) ||
        (group.group_type || group.type) === filterType
      );

      // Check features
      const gFeatures = groupFeaturesMap[groupId];
      const featureMatches = gFeatures?.some(f => {
        if (!matchesSearch(f)) return false;
        if (!filterType) return true;
        if (filterType === 'FOLDER') return false;
        const info = getFeatureDisplayInfo(f, group.group_type || group.type, group.name);
        return (filterType === 'INTERSECTION' && info.isIntersection) || (filterType === 'POLYLINE' && info.isLine) || info.label === filterType;
      });

      // Check sub-groups
      const subGroups = groupParentMap[groupId];
      const subgroupMatches = subGroups?.some(sg => checkGroup(sg.id));

      const isVisible = !!(selfMatches || featureMatches || subgroupMatches);
      map[groupId] = isVisible;
      return isVisible;
    };

    Object.keys(groupsMap).forEach(checkGroup);
    return map;
  }, [groupsMap, groupFeaturesMap, groupParentMap, treeSearchQuery, filterType, matchesSearch]);

  // 4. Final list of filtered regions
  const filteredRegions = useMemo(() => {
    let list = Object.values(regionsMap);
    if (treeSearchQuery || filterType) {
      list = list.filter(r => {
        // Show region if it matches search
        if (matchesSearch(r) && !filterType) return true;

        // Show region if any group inside is visible
        const rGroups = regionGroupsMap[r.id] || [];
        // If map is null, everything is visible
        if (!groupVisibilityMap) return true;
        return rGroups.some(g => groupVisibilityMap[g.id]);
      });
    }
    if (reverseOrder) list = [...list].reverse();
    return list;
  }, [regionsMap, treeSearchQuery, filterType, reverseOrder, regionGroupsMap, groupVisibilityMap, matchesSearch]);

  // V18: Flatten Tree for Virtualization (Now moved after dependencies)
  const flattenedItems = useMemo(() => {
    const result: { type: 'region' | 'group' | 'feature', id: string, level: number, levelOffset: number, data: any }[] = [];
    const visited = new Set<string>();

    const collectFeatures = (featureList: any[], level: number, levelOffset: number) => {
      let currentFeats = featureList;
      if (reverseOrder) currentFeats = [...currentFeats].reverse();

      currentFeats.forEach(f => {
        const searchMatch = !treeSearchQuery || matchesSearch(f);
        if (!searchMatch && !filterType) return; // Skip if no match and no filter active

        // Filter logic
        let show = searchMatch;
        if (filterType && show) {
          const group = groupsMap[f.group_id];
          if (group) {
            const gType = group.group_type || group.type;
            if (gType !== filterType) {
              const info = getFeatureDisplayInfo(f, gType, group.name);
              if (filterType === 'INTERSECTION' && !info.isIntersection) show = false;
              else if (filterType === 'POLYLINE' && !info.isLine) show = false;
              else if (['CCTV', 'PTZ', 'SPEED', 'LPR'].includes(filterType) && info.label !== filterType) show = false;
              else if (filterType === 'FOLDER') show = false;
            }
          }
        }

        if (show) {
          result.push({ type: 'feature', id: f.id, level, levelOffset, data: f });
          if (expanded[`feature-${f.id}`]) {
            const children = featureChildrenMap[f.id] || [];
            collectFeatures(children, level, levelOffset + 1);
          }
        }
      });
    };

    const collectGroups = (parentId: string | null, level: number, regionId?: string) => {
      if (level > 20) return;
      let currentGroups: any[] = [];
      if (!parentId && regionId) {
        currentGroups = (regionGroupsMap[regionId] || []);
      } else {
        currentGroups = (groupParentMap[parentId || 'root'] || []);
      }

      currentGroups.forEach(group => {
        if (visited.has(group.id)) return;
        visited.add(group.id);

        const groupFeatures = (groupFeaturesMap[group.id] || []);
        const hasVisibleContent = groupFeatures.length > 0 || (groupParentMap[group.id] || []).length > 0;

        // Show if matches search OR has matching children
        const searchMatch = !treeSearchQuery || matchesSearch(group);
        if (!searchMatch && !hasVisibleContent) return;

        result.push({ type: 'group', id: group.id, level, levelOffset: 0, data: group });

        if (expanded[group.id]) {
          collectGroups(group.id, level + 1);
          collectFeatures(groupFeatures, level, 0);
        }
      });
    };

    filteredRegions.forEach(region => {
      const searchMatch = !treeSearchQuery || matchesSearch(region);
      const regionGroups = regionGroupsMap[region.id] || [];
      if (!searchMatch && regionGroups.length === 0) return;

      result.push({ type: 'region', id: region.id, level: 0, levelOffset: 0, data: region });

      if (expanded[region.id]) {
        const independentFeatures = (regionIndependentFeaturesMap[region.id] || []);
        collectFeatures(independentFeatures, 1, 0);
        collectGroups(null, 1, region.id);
      }
    });

    return result;
  }, [filteredRegions, expanded, treeSearchQuery, filterType, reverseOrder, featuresMap, groupsMap, regionsMap, featureNumbers, featureChildrenMap, groupParentMap, regionGroupsMap, regionIndependentFeaturesMap, groupFeaturesMap, matchesSearch]);

  // V15: Auto-scroll to selected feature
  const lastScrolledId = useRef<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Only scroll if we have a selection and it's DIFFERENT from what we last scrolled to
    // This prevents annoying jumping when we are just toggling checkboxes or doing multi-select
    if (selectedFeatureId && selectedFeatureId !== lastScrolledId.current && flattenedItems.length > 0) {
      const idx = flattenedItems.findIndex(item => item.type === 'feature' && item.data.id === selectedFeatureId);

      if (idx !== -1 && virtuosoRef.current) {
        lastScrolledId.current = selectedFeatureId;

        // Use a timeout to allow the tree expansion (which happens in a separate effect) 
        // to complete and Virtuoso to recalculate its internal item list and dimensions
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
          if (virtuosoRef.current) {
            virtuosoRef.current.scrollToIndex({
              index: idx,
              align: 'center',
              behavior: 'auto'
            });
          }
        }, 150);
        return () => clearTimeout(timer);
      }
    } else if (!selectedFeatureId) {
      lastScrolledId.current = null;
    }
  }, [selectedFeatureId, flattenedItems]);

  const handleCreateGroup = (regionId: string, e: React.MouseEvent, parentGroupId?: string) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    // Layer is auto-created when Region is created, just find it
    let layer = layers.find(l => l.region_id === regionId);
    if (!layer) {
      // Fallback: create a layer for legacy regions that don't have one
      const layerId = `${regionId}_default_layer`;
      dispatchEvent({
        type: 'LayerCreated',
        payload: { id: layerId, region_id: regionId, name: 'Default Layer' }
      });
      // Use the just-created layer id
      layer = { id: layerId, region_id: regionId, name: 'Default Layer', is_visible: true };
    }

    let group_type = 'default';
    if (!parentGroupId) {
      group_type = 'FOLDER';
    } else {
      const typeChoice = prompt("Chá»n loáº¡i nhÃ³m:\n1. NÃºt giao (Intersection)\n2. Tuyáº¿n (Polyline)\n3. CCTV\n4. PTZ\n5. Speed\n6. LPR\n7. ThÆ° má»¥c (Folder)\n8. Máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh (Default)", "1");
      if (typeChoice === '1') group_type = 'INTERSECTION';
      else if (typeChoice === '2') group_type = 'POLYLINE';
      else if (typeChoice === '3') group_type = 'CCTV';
      else if (typeChoice === '4') group_type = 'PTZ';
      else if (typeChoice === '5') group_type = 'SPEED';
      else if (typeChoice === '6') group_type = 'LPR';
      else if (typeChoice === '7') group_type = 'FOLDER';
    }

    const name = prompt("TÃªn nhÃ³m má»›i:", group_type === 'INTERSECTION' ? 'NÃºt giao má»›i' : 'NhÃ³m má»›i');
    if (!name) return;

    const id = crypto.randomUUID();
    dispatchEvent({
      type: 'FeatureGroupCreated',
      payload: { id, layer_id: layer.id, parent_id: parentGroupId || null, name, group_type }
    });
  };

  const handleCreateRegion = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const name = prompt("TÃªn dá»± Ã¡n má»›i:");
    if (!name) return;

    const id = crypto.randomUUID();
    dispatchEvent({
      type: 'RegionCreated',
      payload: { id, parent_id: null, name }
    });

    // Auto expand the new region
    setExpanded(prev => ({ ...prev, [id]: true }));
  };

  const handleImportToGroup = async (groupId: string) => {
    try {
      const selected = await open({
        multiple: false,
        filters: [{
          name: 'GIS Data',
          extensions: ['xlsx', 'xls', 'kml', 'kmz']
        }]
      });

      if (!selected || typeof selected !== 'string') return;

      const file = selected;
      const fileName = file.split(/[\\/]/).pop() || "";
      const ext = fileName.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase();

      if (ext === 'xlsx' || ext === 'xls' || ext === 'kml' || ext === 'kmz') {
        try {
          const headers = await getExcelHeaders(file);
          if (headers && headers.length > 0) {
            setMappingData({ headers, filename: fileName, groupId, filePath: file });
          } else {
            // Fallback if no specific headers (e.g., very simple KML)
            const records = await importFromKML(file);
            const store = useDesignSync.getState();
            const events = records.map(record => ({
              type: 'FeatureCreated' as const,
              payload: {
                id: record.id,
                layer_id: groupsMap[groupId]?.layer_id || "",
                group_id: groupId,
                name: record.properties.name || `${record.geom_type} Feature`,
                geom_type: record.geom_type,
                metadata: JSON.stringify(record.properties),
                coordinates: record.geometry,
                properties: record.properties
              }
            }));
            await store.dispatchEvents(events);
            alert(`ÄÃ£ import thÃ nh cÃ´ng ${records.length} Ä‘á»‘i tÆ°á»£ng tá»« ${fileName}`);
          }
        } catch (err) {
          alert(`KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ Ä‘á»c dá»¯ liá»‡u tá»« tá»‡p ${ext.toUpperCase()}.`);
        }
      } else {
        alert('Äá»‹nh dáº¡ng tá»‡p khÃ´ng há»— trá»£.');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Import error details:", err);
      alert('CÃ³ lá»—i xáº£y ra khi chá»n file hoáº·c import.');
    }
  };

  const handleMappingConfirm = async (mapping: ImportMapping) => {
    if (!mappingData) return;
    const { filePath, filename, groupId } = mappingData;

    try {
      const records = await importFromExcel(filePath, mapping);
      const store = useDesignSync.getState();

      const events = records.map(record => {
        // Use the cleaned name from the backend if available, otherwise use mapping or fallback
        const name = record.properties.name || record.properties[mapping.name_column] || `${record.geom_type} ${record.id}`;

        // Only override display_order if explicitly mapped, otherwise keep what the backend auto-detected
        const orderId = mapping.order_column ? record.properties[mapping.order_column] : (record.properties.display_order || null);

        // Keep all properties as metadata
        const metadata = {
          ...record.properties,
          display_order: orderId // Explicitly store for easier access
        };

        return {
          type: 'FeatureCreated' as const,
          payload: {
            id: record.id,
            layer_id: groupsMap[groupId]?.layer_id || "",
            group_id: groupId,
            name: name,
            geom_type: record.geom_type,
            metadata: JSON.stringify(metadata),
            coordinates: record.geometry?.coordinates || record.geometry, // Extract array from GeoJSON
            properties: metadata
          }
        };
      });

      await store.dispatchEvents(events);
      alert(`ÄÃ£ import thÃ nh cÃ´ng ${records.length} Ä‘á»‘i tÆ°á»£ng tá»« ${filename}`);
      setMappingData(null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Import conversion error:", err);
      alert('CÃ³ lá»—i xáº£y ra khi chuyá»ƒn Ä‘á»•i dá»¯ liá»‡u mapping.');
    }
  };

  const handleMediaUpload = (groupId: string) => {
    const map = (window as any).leafletMap; // Get map from global if stored, or just use center
    const center = map ? map.getCenter() : { lat: 21.0285, lng: 105.8542 };

    const input = document.createElement('input');
    input.type = 'file';
    input.accept = 'image/*,video/*';
    input.multiple = true;
    input.onchange = async (e: any) => {
      const files = e.target.files as FileList;
      if (!files.length) return;

      for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
        const file = files[i];
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = async (event) => {
          const content = event.target?.result as string;
          const id = crypto.randomUUID();

          dispatchEvent({
            type: 'FeatureCreated',
            payload: {
              id,
              layer_id: groupsMap[groupId]?.layer_id || "",
              group_id: groupId,
              name: file.name,
              geom_type: 'Point',
              coordinates: JSON.stringify([center.lng, center.lat]),
              metadata: JSON.stringify({
                icon: file.type.startsWith('video/') ? 'camera' : 'default',
                color: '#3B82F6',
                imageUrls: [content] // Base64 for temporary session storage
              }),
              properties: JSON.stringify({ type: 'media', fileType: file.type })
            }
          });
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
      }
      alert(`Äang xá»­ lÃ½ upload ${files.length} tá»‡p tin...`);
    };
    input.click();
  };


  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full gap-4 text-center">
        <div className="p-3 rounded-full bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20">
          <Trash2 size={24} className="text-red-500" />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-red-400 uppercase tracking-tight">Lá»—i Náº¡p Dá»¯ Liá»‡u</h3>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-cad-text-muted max-w-[200px] leading-relaxed">
            {error}
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => projectId && initialize(projectId, projectPath || undefined)}
          className="mt-2 px-4 py-1.5 bg-cad-accent text-black text-[10px] font-black uppercase rounded hover:bg-white transition-all flex items-center gap-2"
        >
          <RefreshCw size={12} /> Thá»­ Láº¡i
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isLoading || !state) {
    return (
      <div className="p-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full gap-4 text-center animate-pulse">
        <RefreshCw size={24} className="text-cad-accent animate-spin" />
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-cad-accent">
            Äang Äá»“ng Bá»™...
          </p>
          <div className="w-32 h-1 bg-cad-border rounded-full overflow-hidden">
            <div className="h-full bg-cad-accent animate-[loading_2s_ease-in-out_infinite]" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      className="text-cad-text-primary px-3 py-2 text-[10px] font-mono flex flex-col h-full overflow-hidden"
      onDragStart={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
      onDrop={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
    >
      {/* Search & Filter Bar */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 mb-2 shrink-0">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <div className="relative group/search flex items-center flex-1 bg-cad-bg border border-cad-border focus-within:border-cad-accent transition-all rounded-sm overflow-hidden">
            <div className="pl-2 px-1 text-cad-text-muted group-focus-within/search:text-cad-accent">
              <Search size={10} />
            </div>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={treeSearchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setTreeSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Lá»c tÃªn..."
              className="w-full bg-transparent text-[9px] font-mono py-1 pr-2 text-cad-text-primary placeholder:text-cad-text-muted outline-none uppercase"
            />
            {treeSearchQuery && (
              <button
                onClick={() => setTreeSearchQuery("")}
                className="px-2 text-cad-text-muted hover:text-white"
              >
                Ã—
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={handleCreateRegion}
            className="h-[22px] px-1.5 flex items-center justify-center bg-cad-bg border border-cad-border hover:border-cad-accent hover:text-cad-accent transition-all rounded-sm text-cad-text-muted"
            title="ThÃªm dá»± Ã¡n má»›i (+)"
          >
            <PlusCircle size={12} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Visibility Toggles (V15) */}
        <div className="flex gap-1 px-1.5 py-1.5 border-b border-cad-border/30">
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowNotes(!showNotes)}
            className={cn(
              "flex-1 h-6 flex items-center justify-center rounded-sm text-[8px] font-black uppercase transition-all tracking-tighter whitespace-nowrap",
              !showNotes ? "bg-cad-accent text-black shadow-sm" : "bg-cad-surface border border-cad-border text-cad-text-muted hover:border-cad-accent/50"
            )}
            title="Báº­t/Táº¯t hiá»ƒn thá»‹ Ghi chÃº trong danh sÃ¡ch"
          >
            {!showNotes ? "áº¨N GHI CHÃš" : "HIá»†N GHI CHÃš"}
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => setShowQr(!showQr)}
            className={cn(
              "flex-1 h-6 flex items-center justify-center rounded-sm text-[8px] font-black uppercase transition-all tracking-tighter whitespace-nowrap",
              !showQr ? "bg-cad-accent text-black shadow-sm" : "bg-cad-surface border border-cad-border text-cad-text-muted hover:border-cad-accent/50"
            )}
            title="Báº­t/Táº¯t hiá»ƒn thá»‹ mÃ£ QR trong danh sÃ¡ch"
          >
            {!showQr ? "áº¨N QR" : "HIá»†N QR"}
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => setShowCode(!showCode)}
            className={cn(
              "flex-1 h-6 flex items-center justify-center rounded-sm text-[8px] font-black uppercase transition-all tracking-tighter whitespace-nowrap",
              !showCode ? "bg-cad-accent text-black shadow-sm" : "bg-cad-surface border border-cad-border text-cad-text-muted hover:border-cad-accent/50"
            )}
            title="Báº­t/Táº¯t hiá»ƒn thá»‹ MÃ£ hiá»‡u/STT trong danh sÃ¡ch"
          >
            {!showCode ? "áº¨N MÃƒ HIá»†U" : "HIá»†N MÃƒ HIá»†U"}
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <select
            value={filterType || ""}
            onChange={(e) => setFilterType(e.target.value || null)}
            className="flex-1 bg-cad-surface border border-cad-border text-[8px] font-mono py-0.5 px-1 outline-none text-cad-text-muted focus:border-cad-accent rounded-sm"
          >
            <option value="">Táº¤T Cáº¢ LOáº I</option>
            <option value="INTERSECTION">NÃšT GIAO</option>
            <option value="POLYLINE">TUYáº¾N</option>
            <option value="CCTV">CAMERA CCTV</option>
            <option value="PTZ">CAMERA PTZ</option>
            <option value="SPEED">CAMERA SPEED</option>
            <option value="LPR">CAMERA LPR</option>
            <option value="FOLDER">THÆ¯ Má»¤C</option>
          </select>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 ml-auto">
            <button
              onClick={() => setSortField(sortField === 'name' ? 'stt' : 'name')}
              className={cn(
                "p-1 border border-cad-border rounded-sm transition-all flex items-center gap-1 text-[8px] font-mono h-6",
                sortField === 'stt' ? "bg-cad-accent text-black border-cad-accent" : "hover:border-cad-accent text-cad-text-muted"
              )}
              title="Sáº¯p xáº¿p theo TÃªn/STT"
            >
              <Type size={10} />
              {sortField === 'stt' ? "STT" : "NAME"}
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => setReverseOrder(!reverseOrder)}
              className={cn(
                "p-1 border border-cad-border rounded-sm transition-all flex items-center gap-1 text-[8px] font-mono h-6",
                reverseOrder ? "bg-cad-accent text-black border-cad-accent" : "hover:border-cad-accent text-cad-text-muted"
              )}
              title="Äáº£o ngÆ°á»£c thá»© tá»±"
            >
              <RefreshCw size={10} className={cn(reverseOrder && "rotate-180")} />
              {reverseOrder ? "DESC" : "ASC"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>


      <div
        className="flex-1 min-h-0 pr-1"
```

```tsx
import { useState, KeyboardEvent, useEffect } from "react";
import { cn } from "@TOOL/utils/cn";

interface EditableTextProps {
  value: string;
  onSave: (val: string) => void;
  className?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
}

export function EditableText({ value: initialValue, onSave, className, placeholder }: EditableTextProps) {
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [value, setValue] = useState(initialValue);

  // Sync with external value changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setValue(initialValue);
  }, [initialValue]);

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (value !== initialValue) {
      onSave(value);
    }
    setIsEditing(false);
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      handleSave();
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      setIsEditing(false);
      setValue(initialValue);
    }
  };

  if (isEditing) {
    return (
      <input
        type="text"
        autoFocus
        value={value}
        onChange={e => setValue(e.target.value)}
        onBlur={handleSave}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        className={cn("bg-cad-primary border border-cad-accent outline-none text-white px-1 h-3.5 w-full text-[9px] font-mono", className)}
        onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
        onDoubleClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <span
      className={cn("cursor-text block min-w-[4px] min-h-[1em]", className)}
      onDoubleClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setIsEditing(true); }}
      title={initialValue || placeholder}
    >
      {initialValue || <span className="text-cad-text-muted/40 italic">{placeholder}</span>}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React from "react";
import { Square, MapPin } from "lucide-react";
import { PolylineIcon } from "@DESIGN/components/icons/MapIcons";
import { getFeatureDisplayInfo } from "@TOOL/utils/featureUtils";

export const FeatureIcon = React.memo(({ feature, selected, groupType, groupName }: { feature: any, selected: boolean, groupType?: string, groupName?: string }) => {
  const { icon: Icon, color, gType } = getFeatureDisplayInfo(feature, groupType, groupName);

  if (Icon) {
    return <Icon size={15} style={{ color }} className="shrink-0" />;
  }

  // Geometry based icons for non-special types
  if (gType === 'LINESTRING' || gType === 'POLYLINE') {
    return <PolylineIcon size={15} style={{ color }} className="shrink-0" />;
  }

  if (gType === 'POLYGON') {
    return <Square size={15} style={{ color }} className="shrink-0" />;
  }

  return <MapPin size={15} fill={selected ? color : "none"} className="shrink-0" style={{ color }} />;
});
```

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { X, FileSpreadsheet, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { type ImportMapping } from "@IMPLEMENT/services/importService";

interface MappingDialogProps {
  headers: string[];
  filename: string;
  onConfirm: (mapping: ImportMapping) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function MappingDialog({ headers, filename, onConfirm, onClose }: MappingDialogProps) {
  const [mapping, setMapping] = useState<ImportMapping>({
    name_column: "",
    lat_column: "",
    lng_column: "",
    description_column: ""
  });

  // Auto-detect columns
  useEffect(() => {
    const autoMapping: Partial<ImportMapping> = {};
    
    headers.forEach(h => {
      const lower = h.toLowerCase().trim();
      const includes = (terms: string[]) => terms.some(t => lower.includes(t.toLowerCase()));

      if (includes(["tÃªn", "name", "Ä‘á»‘i tÆ°á»£ng", "label"])) {
        autoMapping.name_column = h;
      } else if (includes(["lat", "latitude", "vÄ© Ä‘á»™"]) || lower === "x") {
        autoMapping.lat_column = h;
      } else if (includes(["lng", "longitude", "kinh Ä‘á»™", "long"]) || lower === "y") {
        autoMapping.lng_column = h;
      } else if (includes(["mÃ´ táº£", "description", "ghi chÃº"])) {
        autoMapping.description_column = h;
      } else if (includes(["stt", "mÃ£ hiá»‡u", "mÃ£", "index", "order", "sá»‘ tt"]) || lower === "id") {
        autoMapping.order_column = h;
      }
    });

    setMapping(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      ...autoMapping
    }));
  }, [headers]);

  const isValid = mapping.name_column && mapping.lat_column && mapping.lng_column;

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    if (isValid) {
```
