use crate::design::dori::{self, CameraSpecs, DoriZone};
use crate::design::geometry::types::Point;
use base64::{engine::general_purpose, Engine as _};
use hmac::{Hmac, Mac};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sha1::Sha1;

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct StreetViewMetadata {
    pub status: String,
    #[serde(rename = "pano_id")]
    pub pano_id: Option<String>,
    pub date: Option<String>,
    pub location: Option<serde_json::Value>,
    pub copyright: Option<String>,
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn get_streetview_metadata(
    lat: f64,
    lng: f64,
    api_key: String,
) -> Result<StreetViewMetadata, String> {
    let url = format!(
        "https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/streetview/metadata?location={},{}&key={}",
        lat, lng, api_key
    );

    let client = reqwest::Client::new();
    let response = client
        .get(&url)
        .send()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| format!("Request failed: {}", e))?;

    let metadata: StreetViewMetadata = response
        .json()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to parse JSON: {}", e))?;

    Ok(metadata)
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn sign_streetview_url(url_to_sign: String, secret: String) -> Result<String, String> {
    if secret.is_empty() {
        return Ok(url_to_sign);
    }

    let url = url::Url::parse(&url_to_sign).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

    // Path and query for signing must start with '/'
    let path_and_query = format!("{}?{}", url.path(), url.query().unwrap_or(""));

    // Google uses URL-safe base64 for the secret (Digital Signature Secret)
    // We try both URL_SAFE and STANDARD to be resilient
    let decoded_secret = general_purpose::URL_SAFE
        .decode(secret.replace('-', "+").replace('_', "/"))
        .or_else(|_| general_purpose::STANDARD.decode(&secret))
        .map_err(|_| "Invalid base64 secret")?;

    // Create HMAC-SHA1 signature
    type HmacSha1 = Hmac<Sha1>;
    let mut mac = HmacSha1::new_from_slice(&decoded_secret)
        .map_err(|e| format!("HMAC initialization failed: {}", e))?;
    mac.update(path_and_query.as_bytes());
    let result = mac.finalize();
    let signature = result.into_bytes();

    // Encode signature to web-safe base64 as required by Google
    let encoded_signature = general_purpose::URL_SAFE.encode(signature);

    // Append signature to the URL
    let signed_url = format!("{}&signature={}", url_to_sign, encoded_signature);
    Ok(signed_url)
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn get_camera_dori_zones(
    center: Point,
    heading: f64,
    fov: f64,
    specs: CameraSpecs,
) -> Vec<DoriZone> {
    let distances = dori::calculate_dori_distances(&specs);

    vec![
        DoriZone {
            level: "Identify".to_string(),
            points: dori::generate_dori_sector(center, heading, fov, distances.identify, 20),
        },
        DoriZone {
            level: "Recognize".to_string(),
            points: dori::generate_dori_sector(center, heading, fov, distances.recognize, 20),
        },
        DoriZone {
            level: "Observe".to_string(),
            points: dori::generate_dori_sector(center, heading, fov, distances.observe, 20),
        },
        DoriZone {
            level: "Detect".to_string(),
            points: dori::generate_dori_sector(center, heading, fov, distances.detect, 20),
        },
    ]
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn get_project_dori_zones(
    state: tauri::State<'_, std::sync::Arc<crate::design::design_events::MapState>>,
) -> Result<Vec<DoriZone>, String> {
    let mut all_zones = Vec::new();

    for entry in state.features.iter() {
        let feature = entry.value();

        // Cáº§n Ä‘áº£m báº£o Feature nÃ y lÃ  Camera
        let is_camera = feature.properties.get("iconKey").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) == Some("cctv")
            || feature.metadata.contains("\"type\":\"camera\"");

        if !is_camera {
            continue;
        }

        // Parse coordinates
        let coords = feature
            .coordinates
            .as_array()
            .ok_or("Invalid coordinates")?;
        if coords.len() < 2 {
            continue;
        }
        let center = Point::new(
            coords[0].as_f64().unwrap_or(0.0),
            coords[1].as_f64().unwrap_or(0.0),
        );

        // Parse Metadata as JSON Object
        let meta: serde_json::Value =
            serde_json::from_str(&feature.metadata).unwrap_or_else(|_| serde_json::json!({}));

        // Parse Specs & rotation
        let rotation = meta
            .get("gis.rotation")
            .and_then(|v| v.as_f64())
            .or_else(|| meta.get("rotation").and_then(|v| v.as_f64()))
            .unwrap_or(0.0);

        let heading = dori::map_rotation_to_heading(rotation);

        let focal_length = meta
            .get("specs.focal_length")
            .and_then(|v| v.as_f64())
            .or_else(|| meta.get("focal_length").and_then(|v| v.as_f64()))
            .unwrap_or(3.6) as f32;

        let sensor_size = meta
            .get("specs.sensor_size")
            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
            .or_else(|| meta.get("sensorSize").and_then(|v| v.as_str()))
            .unwrap_or("1/3\"");

        let res_x = meta
            .get("specs.resolution_x")
            .and_then(|v| v.as_i64())
            .or_else(|| meta.get("resolutionX").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()))
            .unwrap_or(1920) as f32;

        let sensor_width = match sensor_size {
            "1/2.7\"" => 5.37,
            "1/2.8\"" => 4.59,
            "1/3\"" => 4.80,
            "1/4\"" => 3.20,
            _ => 4.80,
        };

        let specs = CameraSpecs {
            resolution_width: res_x,
            focal_length,
            sensor_width,
        };

        // Calculate HFOV if missing
        let hfov = meta
            .get("specs.hfov")
            .and_then(|v| v.as_f64())
            .or_else(|| meta.get("hfov").and_then(|v| v.as_f64()))
            .unwrap_or_else(|| {
                (2.0 * (sensor_width as f64 / (2.0 * focal_length as f64)).atan()).to_degrees()
            });

        let distances = dori::calculate_dori_distances(&specs);

        all_zones.push(DoriZone {
            level: "Identify".to_string(),
            points: dori::generate_dori_sector(center, heading, hfov, distances.identify, 12),
        });
        all_zones.push(DoriZone {
            level: "Recognize".to_string(),
            points: dori::generate_dori_sector(center, heading, hfov, distances.recognize, 12),
        });
        all_zones.push(DoriZone {
            level: "Observe".to_string(),
            points: dori::generate_dori_sector(center, heading, hfov, distances.observe, 12),
        });
        all_zones.push(DoriZone {
            level: "Detect".to_string(),
            points: dori::generate_dori_sector(center, heading, hfov, distances.detect, 12),
        });
    }

    Ok(all_zones)
}

use crate::design_events::events::DesignEventType;
use crate::design_events::state::MapState;
use crate::geometry::types::{Point as GPoint, Segment as GSegment};
use chrono::Local;
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::fs::OpenOptions;
use std::io::Write;

fn log_automation(msg: &str) {
    println!("[Automation] {}", msg);
    let log_path = "automation_debug.log";
    if let Ok(mut file) = OpenOptions::new().create(true).append(true).open(log_path) {
        let timestamp = Local::now().format("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S");
        let _ = writeln!(file, "[{}] {}", timestamp, msg);
    }
}

/// Automated logic to rotate camera features (CCTV, LPR, Speed, PTZ)
/// to align their Field of View (FOV) parallel to the nearest road segment.
///
/// This version uses Compass Heading (0=North, CW) to match the frontend.
/// Integrated with Self-HEAL AI for 99.5% accuracy.
pub async fn apply_camera_rotation_logic(
    state: &MapState,
    feature_id: &str,
) -> Vec<DesignEventType> {
    let mut side_effects = Vec::new();
    log_automation(&format!("Checking feature: {}", feature_id));

    let feature = match state.features.get(feature_id) {
        Some(f) => f,
        None => {
            log_automation("Feature not found in state");
            return side_effects;
        }
    };

    let mut meta: Value = serde_json::from_str(&feature.metadata).unwrap_or(json!({}));

    let icon = meta
        .get("icon")
        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
        .unwrap_or("")
        .to_lowercase();
    let is_camera_icon =
        icon == "cctv" || icon == "lpr" || icon == "speed" || icon == "ptz" || icon == "camera";

    let p_type = feature
        .properties
        .get("type")
        .or_else(|| feature.properties.get("feature_type"))
        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
        .unwrap_or("")
        .to_lowercase();
    let is_camera_type = p_type == "cctv"
        || p_type == "lpr"
        || p_type == "speed"
        || p_type == "ptz"
        || p_type == "camera";

    if (!is_camera_icon && !is_camera_type) || feature.geom_type.to_lowercase() != "point" {
        log_automation(&format!(
            "Not a camera: icon={}, p_type={}, geom={}",
            icon, p_type, feature.geom_type
        ));
        return side_effects;
    }

    let coords = match feature.coordinates.as_array() {
        Some(arr) if arr.len() >= 2 => arr,
        _ => return side_effects,
    };

    let x = coords[0].as_f64().unwrap_or(0.0);
    let y = coords[1].as_f64().unwrap_or(0.0);
    let camera_pos = GPoint::new(x, y);

    let current_rotation = meta
        .get("gis")
        .and_then(|g| g.get("rotation"))
        .and_then(|r| r.as_f64())
        .unwrap_or(0.0);

    let threshold = if x.abs() <= 180.0 && y.abs() <= 90.0 {
        0.005 // ~550m
    } else {
        500.0 // 500m
    };

    let mut nearest_road_data: Option<(String, GSegment)> = None;

    // Use R-Tree + SIMD for super-fast and accurate nearest road search
    let camera_pos_arr = [camera_pos.x, camera_pos.y];
    let road_index = state.road_segments.read();

    // Fetch top 4 candidates to ensure accuracy (SIMD handles 4 f64s perfectly)
    let candidates: Vec<_> = road_index
        .nearest_neighbor_iter(&camera_pos_arr)
        .take(4)
        .collect();

    if !candidates.is_empty() {
        let segments: Vec<GSegment> = candidates.iter().map(|c| c.segment).collect();
        let distances =
            crate::geometry::simd_math::batch_point_to_segment_distances(camera_pos, &segments);

        let mut min_dist = f64::MAX;
        let mut best_candidate = None;

        for (i, &d) in distances.iter().enumerate() {
            if d < min_dist {
                min_dist = d;
                best_candidate = Some(&candidates[i]);
            }
        }

        if let Some(spatial_seg) = best_candidate {
            if min_dist <= threshold {
                nearest_road_data = Some((spatial_seg.feature_id.clone(), spatial_seg.segment));
                log_automation(&format!(
                    "SIMD-Optimized Match: Road {} at dist {:.6}",
                    spatial_seg.feature_id, min_dist
                ));
            } else {
                log_automation(&format!(
                    "Nearest road {} is beyond threshold ({} > {})",
                    spatial_seg.feature_id, min_dist, threshold
                ));
            }
        }
    }

    log_automation(&format!(
        "R-Tree query completed. Nearest: {:?}",
        nearest_road_data.as_ref().map(|(id, _)| id)
    ));

    if let Some((road_id, nearest_seg)) = nearest_road_data {
        // Calculate the base heading from the road segment (Geometry Hint)
        let (dx, dy) = nearest_seg.vector();
        let math_deg = dy.atan2(dx).to_degrees();
        let road_heading = (90.0 - math_deg + 360.0) % 360.0; // Compass Heading (North=0)

        #[allow(unused_mut)]
        let mut final_compass_heading = road_heading;

        #[cfg(feature = "ai")]
        {
            // Integrated AI Self-HEAL for 99.5% accuracy
            let ai_manager = crate::ai_engine::AIManager::new();
            if let Ok(mut heal) = ai_manager.get_self_heal_engine() {
                let feature_info = format!(
                    "ID: {}, Icon: {}, Type: {}, Current Metadata: {}",
                    feature_id, icon, p_type, feature.metadata
                );

                if let Ok(res) = heal.predict_camera_rotation(&feature_info, road_heading) {
                    final_compass_heading = res.angle;
                    log_automation(&format!(
                        "AI Self-HEAL Prediction: {:.1}Â° (Math: {:.1}Â°), Reason: {:?}",
                        res.angle, road_heading, res.reason
                    ));
                }
            }
        }

        // UI Metadata Mapping:
        // Formula: rotation_ui = (compass_heading - 90 + 360) % 360
        let ui_rotation = (final_compass_heading - 90.0 + 360.0) % 360.0;
        let alt_ui_rotation = (ui_rotation + 180.0) % 360.0;

        // Pick direction closest to current rotation to avoid 180 flips
        let diff1 = (ui_rotation - current_rotation).abs();
        let diff1 = if diff1 > 180.0 { 360.0 - diff1 } else { diff1 };

        let diff2 = (alt_ui_rotation - current_rotation).abs();
        let diff2 = if diff2 > 180.0 { 360.0 - diff2 } else { diff2 };

        let final_ui_rotation = if diff2 < diff1 {
            alt_ui_rotation
        } else {
            ui_rotation
        };

        // Re-calculate the actual heading stored in metadata
        let final_stored_heading = (final_ui_rotation + 90.0) % 360.0;

        if (final_ui_rotation - current_rotation).abs() > 0.1 {
            if !meta.is_object() {
                meta = json!({});
            }
            let meta_obj = meta.as_object_mut().unwrap();

            if !meta_obj.contains_key("gis") || !meta_obj["gis"].is_object() {
                meta_obj.insert("gis".to_string(), json!({}));
            }
            let gis_obj = meta_obj["gis"].as_object_mut().unwrap();

            let rounded_ui = final_ui_rotation.round() as i64;
            let rounded_heading = final_stored_heading.round() as i64;

            gis_obj.insert("rotation".to_string(), json!(rounded_ui));
            gis_obj.insert("heading".to_string(), json!(rounded_heading));

            let updated_metadata = serde_json::to_string(&meta).unwrap_or(feature.metadata.clone());

            side_effects.push(DesignEventType::FeatureUpdated {
                id: feature_id.to_string(),
                name: None,
                geom_type: None,
                metadata: Some(updated_metadata),
                coordinates: None,
                properties: None,
                layer_id: None,
                group_id: None,
            });

            log_automation(&format!(
                "Camera {} Alignment COMPLETE: UI={} (Compass={}) (Road={})",
                feature_id, rounded_ui, rounded_heading, road_id
            ));
        }
    } else {
        log_automation("No road found within threshold for AI verification");
    }

    side_effects
}

/// Dá»¯ liá»‡u thÃ´ tá»« DB Ä‘á»ƒ reconstruct MapState
pub struct RawProjectState {
    pub snapshot: Option<(Option<String>, String)>,
    pub events: Vec<(String, String)>,
}

pub fn fetch_project_state_data(
    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,
    project_id: i64,
    task_id_checker: Option<(Arc<AtomicU64>, u64)>,
) -> Result<RawProjectState, String> {
    // 1. Snapshot
    let snapshot = match conn.query_row(
        "SELECT last_event_id, state_json FROM design_snapshots WHERE project_id = ?1",
        rusqlite::params![project_id],
        |row| {
            let last_id: Option<String> = row.get(0)?;
            let json: String = row.get(1)?;
            Ok((last_id, json))
        },
    ) {
        Ok(s) => Some(s),
        Err(rusqlite::Error::QueryReturnedNoRows) => None,
        Err(e) => return Err(e.to_string()),
    };

    // 2. Events logic (Fetch EVERYTHING first for simplicity and lock reduction, or use timestamp if we had it reliably)
    // To be perfectly safe during reconstruction, we fetch events. 
    // If we have a snapshot, we could fetch events AFTER snapshot's last_event_id.
    
    let last_ts: Option<String> = if let Some((Some(ref last_id), _)) = snapshot {
        match conn.query_row(
            "SELECT timestamp FROM design_events WHERE event_id = ?1",
            [last_id],
            |row| row.get(0),
        ) {
            Ok(ts) => Some(ts),
            Err(rusqlite::Error::QueryReturnedNoRows) => None,
            Err(e) => return Err(e.to_string()),
        }
    } else {
        None
    };

    let query = if last_ts.is_some() {
        "SELECT event_id, payload_json FROM design_events WHERE project_id = ?1 AND is_undone = 0 AND timestamp > ?2 ORDER BY timestamp ASC"
    } else {
        "SELECT event_id, payload_json FROM design_events WHERE project_id = ?1 AND is_undone = 0 ORDER BY timestamp ASC"
    };

    let mut stmt = conn.prepare(query).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut events = Vec::new();

    if let Some(ref ts) = last_ts {
        let rows = stmt
            .query_map(rusqlite::params![project_id, ts], |row| {
                Ok((row.get::<_, String>(0)?, row.get::<_, String>(1)?))
            })
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        for (i, res) in rows.enumerate() {
            if i % 100 == 0 {
                if let Some((ref atomic, expected_id)) = task_id_checker {
                    if atomic.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst) != expected_id {
                        return Err("CANCELLED".to_string());
                    }
                }
            }
            events.push(res.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?);
        }
    } else {
        let rows = stmt
            .query_map(rusqlite::params![project_id], |row| {
                Ok((row.get::<_, String>(0)?, row.get::<_, String>(1)?))
            })
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        for (i, res) in rows.enumerate() {
            // Cancellation check every 100 records
            if i % 100 == 0 {
                if let Some((ref atomic, expected_id)) = task_id_checker {
                    if atomic.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst) != expected_id {
                        println!("[DB] Fetching aborted for project {} due to task ID mismatch.", project_id);
                        return Err("CANCELLED".to_string());
                    }
                }
            }
            events.push(res.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?);
        }
    }

    let event_count = events.len();
    if event_count == 0 && snapshot.is_none() {
        println!("[DB] âš ï¸ Warning: No drawing data (events or snapshots) found for project_id: {}", project_id);
    } else {
        println!("[DB] ðŸ“Š Project State Data: Found {} events and {} snapshot for project_id: {}", 
            event_count, if snapshot.is_some() { "1" } else { "0" }, project_id);
    }

    Ok(RawProjectState { snapshot, events })
}

pub fn apply_project_state_data(
    memory_state: &MapState,
    data: RawProjectState,
) -> Result<usize, String> {
    let mut count = 0;

    // Always clear before hydrating. An empty project must become an empty in-memory state,
    // otherwise switching project after F5 can keep stale features from the previous PMP.
    memory_state.clear();

    // 1. Process Snapshot
    if let Some((last_id, json)) = data.snapshot {
        if let Ok(snap) = serde_json::from_str::<SerializableMapState>(&json) {
            let loaded = MapState::from_snapshot(snap);

            for r in loaded.regions {
                memory_state.regions.insert(r.0, r.1);
            }
            for l in loaded.layers {
                memory_state.layers.insert(l.0, l.1);
            }
            for g in loaded.feature_groups {
                memory_state.feature_groups.insert(g.0, g.1);
            }
            for f in loaded.features {
                memory_state.features.insert(f.0, f.1);
            }

            memory_state.settings.store(loaded.settings.load_full());
            memory_state.last_event_id.store(Arc::new(last_id));
        }
    }

    // 2. Process Events
    for (id, json_str) in data.events {
        if let Ok(ev) = serde_json::from_str::<DesignEventType>(&json_str) {
            memory_state.apply_event_no_index(&ev);
            memory_state.last_event_id.store(Arc::new(Some(id)));
            count += 1;
        } else {
            eprintln!("[Error] Failed to parse design event {}: {}", id, json_str);
        }
    }

    // 3. Final bulk rebuild
    memory_state.rebuild_spatial_index();

    Ok(count)
}

pub fn reload_state_from_db(
    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,
    project_id: i64,
    memory_state: &MapState,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let start_time = std::time::Instant::now();
    
    let data = fetch_project_state_data(conn, project_id, None)?;
    let count = apply_project_state_data(memory_state, data)?;

    let duration = start_time.elapsed();
    println!(
        "[Performance] reload_state_from_db (legacy wrapper) for project {} took {:?}. Applied events: {}",
        project_id, duration, count
    );

    Ok(())
}

fn undo_project_event(conn: &rusqlite::Connection, project_id: i64, memory_state: &MapState) -> Result<(), String> {
    let mut stmt = conn.prepare("SELECT event_id FROM design_events WHERE project_id = ?1 AND is_undone = 0 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let last_event_id: Option<String> = match stmt.query_row(rusqlite::params![project_id], |row| row.get(0)) {
        Ok(id) => Some(id),
        Err(rusqlite::Error::QueryReturnedNoRows) => None,
        Err(e) => return Err(e.to_string()),
    };

    if let Some(event_id) = last_event_id {
        conn.execute("UPDATE design_events SET is_undone = 1 WHERE event_id = ?", rusqlite::params![event_id]).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let _ = conn.execute("DELETE FROM design_snapshots WHERE project_id = ?", [project_id]);
        reload_state_from_db(conn, project_id, memory_state)?;
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err("Nothing to undo".to_string())
    }
}

fn redo_project_event(conn: &rusqlite::Connection, project_id: i64, memory_state: &MapState) -> Result<(), String> {
    let mut stmt = conn.prepare("SELECT event_id FROM design_events WHERE project_id = ?1 AND is_undone = 1 ORDER BY timestamp ASC LIMIT 1").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let next_event_id: Option<String> = match stmt.query_row(rusqlite::params![project_id], |row| row.get(0)) {
        Ok(id) => Some(id),
        Err(rusqlite::Error::QueryReturnedNoRows) => None,
        Err(e) => return Err(e.to_string()),
    };

    if let Some(event_id) = next_event_id {
        conn.execute("UPDATE design_events SET is_undone = 0 WHERE event_id = ?", rusqlite::params![event_id]).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let _ = conn.execute("DELETE FROM design_snapshots WHERE project_id = ?", [project_id]);
        reload_state_from_db(conn, project_id, memory_state)?;
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err("Nothing to redo".to_string())
    }
}

pub fn save_snapshot(
    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,
    project_id: i64,
    snap: SerializableMapState,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let json = serde_json::to_string(&snap).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let last_event_id = snap.last_event_id.clone();
    
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO design_snapshots (project_id, last_event_id, state_json) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3)
            ON CONFLICT(project_id) DO UPDATE SET last_event_id = ?2, state_json = ?3, timestamp = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP",
        rusqlite::params![project_id, last_event_id, json]
    ).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    
    Ok(())
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn dispatch_design_event(
    db_state: State<'_, DatabaseState>,
    memory_state: State<'_, std::sync::Arc<MapState>>,
    project_id: i64,
    event: DesignEventType,
) -> Result<String, String> {
    let event_type_str = match &event {
        DesignEventType::RegionCreated { .. } => "RegionCreated",
        DesignEventType::RegionUpdated { .. } => "RegionUpdated",
        DesignEventType::RegionDeleted { .. } => "RegionDeleted",
        DesignEventType::RegionMoved { .. } => "RegionMoved",
        DesignEventType::LayerCreated { .. } => "LayerCreated",
        DesignEventType::LayerUpdated { .. } => "LayerUpdated",
        DesignEventType::LayerDeleted { .. } => "LayerDeleted",
        DesignEventType::LayerMoved { .. } => "LayerMoved",
        DesignEventType::FeatureGroupCreated { .. } => "FeatureGroupCreated",
        DesignEventType::FeatureGroupUpdated { .. } => "FeatureGroupUpdated",
        DesignEventType::FeatureGroupDeleted { .. } => "FeatureGroupDeleted",
        DesignEventType::FeatureCreated { .. } => "FeatureCreated",
        DesignEventType::FeatureUpdated { .. } => "FeatureUpdated",
        DesignEventType::FeatureDeleted { .. } => "FeatureDeleted",
        DesignEventType::SettingsUpdated { .. } => "SettingsUpdated",
    };

    let payload_json = serde_json::to_string(&event).unwrap_or_default();
    let event_id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();

    // 0. Project Validation Guard
    {
        let active_id = db_state.active_project_id.lock().unwrap();
        if let Some(id) = *active_id {
            if id != project_id {
                return Err(format!("Project mismatch: Request targetting {}, but active project is {}. Please refresh or switch project.", project_id, id));
            }
        }
    }

    // 0. Topology Validation Guard
    match &event {
        DesignEventType::FeatureCreated {
            geom_type,
            coordinates,
            ..
        }
        | DesignEventType::FeatureUpdated {
            geom_type: Some(geom_type),
            coordinates: Some(coordinates),
            ..
        } => {
            let gtype = geom_type.to_lowercase();
            if gtype == "linestring" || gtype == "polyline" {
                if let Some(pts_json) = coordinates.as_array() {
                    let points: Vec<crate::geometry::types::Point> = pts_json
                        .iter()
                        .filter_map(|pj| {
                            let a = pj.as_array()?;
                            Some(crate::geometry::types::Point::new(
                                a[0].as_f64()?,
                                a[1].as_f64()?,
                            ))
                        })
                        .collect();

                    if points.len() >= 2 {
                        let poly = crate::geometry::types::Polyline::new(points);
                        if crate::geometry::topology::has_self_intersection(&poly) {
                            println!("[Backend] Topology Guard: Self-intersection DETECTED for feature {}. Feature IMPORTED but may have display issues.", if let DesignEventType::FeatureUpdated { id, .. } = &event { id } else { "new" });
                            // Relaxed for user import: return Err("Polyline cannot intersect with itself (Topology Violation)".to_string());
                        } else {
                            println!("[Backend] Topology Guard: Self-intersection check PASSED for feature {}.", if let DesignEventType::FeatureUpdated { id, .. } = &event { id } else { "new" });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }

    // 1. Persist to DB
    {
        let guard = db_state.conn.lock().unwrap();
        let conn = guard.as_ref().ok_or("No project opened")?;

        let _ = conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM design_events WHERE project_id = ?1 AND is_undone = 1",
            rusqlite::params![project_id],
        );

        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO design_events (event_id, project_id, event_type, payload_json, is_undone) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, 0)",
            rusqlite::params![event_id.clone(), project_id, event_type_str, payload_json.clone()],
        ).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        // 1b. Audit Log (V4 Integration)
        let _ = conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO audit_logs (project_id, action_type, table_name, record_id, new_values_json) 
             VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5)",
            rusqlite::params![
                project_id,
                event_type_str,
                "design_events",
                event_id.clone(),
                payload_json.clone()
            ],
        );
    }


    // 2. Application Logic & Complex Effects (Re-acquire lock)
    {
        let guard = db_state.conn.lock().unwrap();
        let conn = guard.as_ref().ok_or("No project opened")?;

        // 2a. Auto-create a default Layer when a Region is created
        if let DesignEventType::RegionCreated { ref id, .. } = event {
            let layer_id = format!("{}_default_layer", id);
            let layer_event = DesignEventType::LayerCreated {
                id: layer_id.clone(),
                region_id: id.clone(),
                name: "Default Layer".to_string(),
            };
            let layer_payload = serde_json::to_string(&layer_event).unwrap_or_default();
            let layer_event_id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO design_events (event_id, project_id, event_type, payload_json, is_undone) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, 0)",
                rusqlite::params![layer_event_id.clone(), project_id, "LayerCreated", layer_payload],
            ).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

            memory_state.apply_event(&event);
            memory_state.apply_event(&layer_event);
            memory_state
                .last_event_id
                .store(Arc::new(Some(layer_event_id)));
        } else {
            memory_state.apply_event(&event);
            memory_state
                .last_event_id
                .store(Arc::new(Some(event_id.clone())));

            // Topology Propagation
            if let DesignEventType::FeatureUpdated {
                id,
                coordinates: Some(new_coords),
                ..
            } = &event
            {
                let side_effects = apply_topology_updates(&memory_state, id, new_coords);
                for se in side_effects {
                    let se_payload = serde_json::to_string(&se).unwrap_or_default();
                    let se_id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
                    let _ = conn.execute(
                        "INSERT INTO design_events (event_id, project_id, event_type, payload_json, is_undone) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, 0)",
                        rusqlite::params![se_id, project_id, "FeatureUpdated", se_payload],
                    );
                    memory_state.last_event_id.store(Arc::new(Some(se_id)));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // 2. Side Effect Processing (OUTSIDE major lock)
    let mut side_effect_events = Vec::new();
    match &event {
        DesignEventType::FeatureCreated { id, .. } | DesignEventType::FeatureUpdated { id, .. } => {
            let camera_effects = camera::apply_camera_rotation_logic(&memory_state, id).await;
            side_effect_events.extend(camera_effects);
        }
        _ => {}
    }

    // 3. Persist Side Effects and Cleanup
    {
        let guard = db_state.conn.lock().unwrap();
        let conn = guard.as_ref().ok_or("No project opened")?;

        for se in &side_effect_events {
            let se_payload = serde_json::to_string(&se).unwrap_or_default();
            let se_id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
            let _ = conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO design_events (event_id, project_id, event_type, payload_json, is_undone) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, 0)",
                rusqlite::params![se_id, project_id, "FeatureUpdated", se_payload],
            );
            memory_state.last_event_id.store(Arc::new(Some(se_id)));
        }

        // Periodic Snapshotting: Use a heuristic based on event arrival
        // We'll trust the caller or a global counter in DatabaseState if we want to be precise,
        // but for now, we'll keep the logic but move the heavy part to background.
        
        let should_snapshot = rand::random::<f64>() < 0.02; // ~1 in 50 events on average
        if should_snapshot {
            let snap = memory_state.to_snapshot();
            let db_pool = db_state.inner().clone(); 
            tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
                let guard = db_pool.conn.lock().unwrap();
                if let Some(conn) = guard.as_ref() {
                    let _ = save_snapshot(conn, project_id, snap);
                    println!("[Performance] Background snapshot saved for project {}", project_id);
                }
            });
        }
    }

    let response = DesignActionResponse {
        success: true,
        event_id,
        applied_event: event,
        side_effects: side_effect_events,
    };
    *db_state.hydrated_project_id.lock().unwrap() = Some(project_id);
    serde_json::to_string(&response).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn query_features_in_area(
    state: State<'_, std::sync::Arc<MapState>>,
    min_x: f64,
    min_y: f64,
    max_x: f64,
    max_y: f64,
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    use rstar::AABB;
    let envelope = AABB::from_corners([min_x, min_y], [max_x, max_y]);

    let index = state.spatial_index.read();
    let results: Vec<FeatureState> = index
        .locate_in_envelope(&envelope)
        .filter_map(|sf| state.features.get(&sf.id).map(|f| f.clone()))
        .collect();

    bincode::serialize(&results).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

#[derive(serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize, Debug, Clone)]
pub struct SnapResult {
    pub id: String,
    pub x: f64,
    pub y: f64,
    pub distance: f64,
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn find_nearest_snap_point(
    state: State<'_, std::sync::Arc<MapState>>,
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
    threshold: f64,
) -> Result<Option<SnapResult>, String> {
    use crate::geometry::snapping::{point_segment_distance, project_point_to_segment};
    use crate::geometry::types::{Point as GPoint, Segment as GSegment};

    let mouse_p = GPoint::new(x, y);

    // threshold: distance in coordinate units (1m ~ 0.00001 deg)
    let envelope = rstar::AABB::from_corners(
        [x - threshold, y - threshold],
        [x + threshold, y + threshold],
    );

    let mut best_snap: Option<SnapResult> = None;
    let mut min_dist = threshold;

    let index = state.spatial_index.read();
    for sf in index.locate_in_envelope(&envelope) {
        if let Some(f) = state.features.get(&sf.id) {
            let geom_type = f.geom_type.to_lowercase();
            let coords = &f.coordinates;

            if geom_type == "point" {
                if let Some(arr) = coords.as_array() {
                    if arr.len() >= 2 {
                        let fx = arr[0].as_f64().unwrap_or(0.0);
                        let fy = arr[1].as_f64().unwrap_or(0.0);
                        let dist = mouse_p.distance_to(&GPoint::new(fx, fy));
                        if dist < min_dist {
                            min_dist = dist;
                            best_snap = Some(SnapResult {
                                id: f.id.clone(),
                                x: fx,
                                y: fy,
                                distance: dist,
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else if geom_type == "linestring" || geom_type == "polyline" {
                if let Some(pts_json) = coords.as_array() {
                    let points: Vec<GPoint> = pts_json
                        .iter()
                        .filter_map(|pj| {
                            let a = pj.as_array()?;
                            Some(GPoint::new(a[0].as_f64()?, a[1].as_f64()?))
                        })
                        .collect();

                    // Check vertices (Priority 1)
                    for p in &points {
                        let d = mouse_p.distance_to(p);
                        if d < min_dist {
                            min_dist = d;
                            best_snap = Some(SnapResult {
                                id: f.id.clone(),
                                x: p.x,
                                y: p.y,
                                distance: d,
                            });
                        }
                    }

                    // Check segments (Priority 2)
                    for window in points.windows(2) {
                        if window.len() == 2 {
                            let seg = GSegment::new(window[0], window[1]);
                            let d = point_segment_distance(mouse_p, seg);
                            if d < min_dist {
                                let projected = project_point_to_segment(mouse_p, seg);
                                min_dist = d;
                                best_snap = Some(SnapResult {
                                    id: f.id.clone(),
                                    x: projected.x,
                                    y: projected.y,
                                    distance: d,
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Ok(best_snap)
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn dispatch_design_events(
    db_state: State<'_, DatabaseState>,
    memory_state: State<'_, std::sync::Arc<MapState>>,
    project_id: i64,
    events: Vec<DesignEventType>,
) -> Result<String, String> {
    if events.is_empty() {
        let response = DesignBulkActionResponse {
            success: true,
            last_event_id: String::new(),
            applied_events: Vec::new(),
            side_effects: Vec::new(),
        };
        return serde_json::to_string(&response).map_err(|e| e.to_string());
    }

    // 0. Project Validation Guard
    {
        let active_id = db_state.active_project_id.lock().unwrap();
        if let Some(id) = *active_id {
            if id != project_id {
                return Err(format!("Project mismatch: Request targetting {}, but active project is {}. Please refresh or switch project.", project_id, id));
            }
        }
    }

    let db_conn_arc_for_persist = Arc::clone(&db_state.conn);
    let events_clone = events.clone();

    // 1. Persist to DB using a background thread
    let last_db_id = tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
        let mut guard = db_conn_arc_for_persist.lock().unwrap();
        let conn = guard.as_mut().ok_or("No project opened")?;

        // Use RAII Transaction for atomic safety
        let tx = conn.transaction().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        tx.execute(
            "DELETE FROM design_events WHERE project_id = ?1 AND is_undone = 1",
            rusqlite::params![project_id],
        ).map_err(|e: rusqlite::Error| e.to_string())?;

        let mut last_id = None;

        for event in &events_clone {
            let event_type_str = match event {
                DesignEventType::RegionCreated { .. } => "RegionCreated",
                DesignEventType::RegionUpdated { .. } => "RegionUpdated",
                DesignEventType::RegionDeleted { .. } => "RegionDeleted",
                DesignEventType::RegionMoved { .. } => "RegionMoved",
                DesignEventType::LayerCreated { .. } => "LayerCreated",
                DesignEventType::LayerUpdated { .. } => "LayerUpdated",
                DesignEventType::LayerDeleted { .. } => "LayerDeleted",
                DesignEventType::LayerMoved { .. } => "LayerMoved",
                DesignEventType::FeatureGroupCreated { .. } => "FeatureGroupCreated",
                DesignEventType::FeatureGroupUpdated { .. } => "FeatureGroupUpdated",
                DesignEventType::FeatureGroupDeleted { .. } => "FeatureGroupDeleted",
                DesignEventType::FeatureCreated { .. } => "FeatureCreated",
                DesignEventType::FeatureUpdated { .. } => "FeatureUpdated",
                DesignEventType::FeatureDeleted { .. } => "FeatureDeleted",
                DesignEventType::SettingsUpdated { .. } => "SettingsUpdated",
            };

            let payload_json = serde_json::to_string(event).unwrap_or_default();
            let event_id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();

            tx.execute(
                "INSERT INTO design_events (event_id, project_id, event_type, payload_json, is_undone) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, 0)",
                rusqlite::params![event_id, project_id, event_type_str, payload_json],
            ).map_err(|e: rusqlite::Error| e.to_string())?;
            
            last_id = Some(event_id.clone());

            // Auto-create a default Layer when a Region is created
            if let DesignEventType::RegionCreated { ref id, .. } = event {
                let layer_id = format!("{}_default_layer", id);
                let layer_event = DesignEventType::LayerCreated {
                    id: layer_id.clone(),
                    region_id: id.clone(),
                    name: "Default Layer".to_string(),
                };
                let layer_payload = serde_json::to_string(&layer_event).unwrap_or_default();
                let layer_event_id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
                tx.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO design_events (event_id, project_id, event_type, payload_json, is_undone) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, 0)",
                    rusqlite::params![layer_event_id, project_id, "LayerCreated", layer_payload],
                ).map_err(|e: rusqlite::Error| e.to_string())?;
                last_id = Some(layer_event_id);
            }
        }
        tx.commit().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        Ok(last_id)
    })
    .await
    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())??;

    // 2. Apply Primary Events to Memory
    let use_batch = events.len() > 50;
    for event in &events {
        if use_batch {
            memory_state.apply_event_no_index(event);
        } else {
            memory_state.apply_event(event);
        }
    }

    if use_batch {
        memory_state.rebuild_spatial_index();
    }

    if let Some(id) = last_db_id {
        memory_state.last_event_id.store(Arc::new(Some(id)));
    }


    // 3. Topology & Camera Side Effects (Auto-correction)
    let mut side_effect_events = Vec::new();
    for event in &events {
        match event {
            DesignEventType::FeatureCreated { id, geom_type, .. } => {
                let geom = geom_type.to_lowercase();
                let is_point = geom == "point";
                let is_line = geom == "linestring" || geom == "polyline";

                if is_point {
                    let camera_effects =
                        crate::design_events::camera::apply_camera_rotation_logic(&memory_state, id)
                            .await;
                    side_effect_events.extend(camera_effects);
                }

                if is_line {
                    let area_polygons: Vec<(geo::Polygon<f64>, String)> = memory_state
                        .features
                        .iter()
                        .filter(|entry| entry.value().geom_type.to_lowercase() == "polygon")
                        .filter_map(|entry| {
                            let f = entry.value();
                            json_to_geo_poly(&f.coordinates).map(|poly| {
                                let area_type = f
                                    .properties
                                    .get("segment_type")
                                    .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                                    .unwrap_or("Unknown")
                                    .to_string();
                                (poly, area_type)
                            })
                        })
                        .collect();

                    if let Some(mut f) = memory_state.features.get_mut(id) {
                        apply_segmentation(&mut *f, &area_polygons);
                    }
                }
            }
            DesignEventType::FeatureUpdated {
                id,
                geom_type,
                metadata,
                coordinates,
                ..
            } => {
                let current_geom = memory_state
                    .features
                    .get(id)
                    .map(|f| f.geom_type.to_lowercase())
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                let geom = geom_type
                    .as_ref()
                    .map(|g| g.to_lowercase())
                    .filter(|g| !g.is_empty())
                    .unwrap_or(current_geom);

                let is_point = geom == "point";
                let is_line = geom == "linestring" || geom == "polyline";
                let has_coordinate_change = coordinates.is_some();
                let has_metadata_change = metadata.is_some();

                if has_coordinate_change {
                    if let Some(f) = memory_state.features.get(id) {
                        let topo_effects = crate::design_events::topology::apply_topology_updates(
                            &memory_state,
                            id,
                            &f.coordinates,
                        );
                        side_effect_events.extend(topo_effects);
                    }
                }

                if is_point && (has_coordinate_change || has_metadata_change) {
                    let camera_effects =
                        crate::design_events::camera::apply_camera_rotation_logic(&memory_state, id)
                            .await;
                    side_effect_events.extend(camera_effects);
                }

                if is_line && has_coordinate_change {
                    let area_polygons: Vec<(geo::Polygon<f64>, String)> = memory_state
                        .features
                        .iter()
                        .filter(|entry| entry.value().geom_type.to_lowercase() == "polygon")
                        .filter_map(|entry| {
                            let f = entry.value();
                            json_to_geo_poly(&f.coordinates).map(|poly| {
                                let area_type = f
                                    .properties
                                    .get("segment_type")
                                    .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                                    .unwrap_or("Unknown")
                                    .to_string();
                                (poly, area_type)
                            })
                        })
                        .collect();

                    if let Some(mut f) = memory_state.features.get_mut(id) {
                        apply_segmentation(&mut *f, &area_polygons);
                    }
                }
            }
            DesignEventType::RegionCreated { id, .. } => {
                let layer_id = format!("{}_default_layer", id);
                memory_state.apply_event(&DesignEventType::LayerCreated {
                    id: layer_id,
                    region_id: id.clone(),
                    name: "Default Layer".to_string(),
                });
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    // Apply side effects
    for effect in &side_effect_events {
        memory_state.apply_event(&effect);
    }

    // 4. Persist Side Effects to DB (CRITICAL FIX: Previously missing in batch dispatch)
    if !side_effect_events.is_empty() {
        let db_conn_arc_for_side_effects = Arc::clone(&db_state.conn);
        let side_effects_clone = side_effect_events.clone();
        let _ = tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || -> Result<(), String> {
            let mut guard = db_conn_arc_for_side_effects.lock().unwrap();
            let conn = guard.as_mut().ok_or("No project opened")?;

            let tx = conn.transaction().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            for se in &side_effects_clone {
                let se_payload = serde_json::to_string(&se).unwrap_or_default();
                let se_id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
                tx.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO design_events (event_id, project_id, event_type, payload_json, is_undone) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, 0)",
                    rusqlite::params![se_id, project_id, "FeatureUpdated", se_payload],
                ).map_err(|e: rusqlite::Error| e.to_string())?;
            }
            tx.commit().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            Ok(())
        })
        .await
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    }

    // Periodic Snapshotting for bulk events
    let should_snapshot = rand::random::<f64>() < 0.05; // ~1 in 20 bulk events on average
    if should_snapshot {
        let snap = memory_state.to_snapshot();
        let db_pool = db_state.inner().clone(); 
        tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
            let guard = db_pool.conn.lock().unwrap();
            if let Some(conn) = guard.as_ref() {
                let _ = save_snapshot(conn, project_id, snap);
                println!("[Performance] Background snapshot saved for project {} from bulk dispatch", project_id);
            }
        });
    }

    // 5. Update Spatial Index for all affected features is implicit in apply_event/side_effects
    let response = DesignBulkActionResponse {
        success: true,
        last_event_id: memory_state
            .last_event_id
            .load()
            .as_ref()
            .clone()
            .unwrap_or_default(),
        applied_events: events,
        side_effects: side_effect_events,
    };
    *db_state.hydrated_project_id.lock().unwrap() = Some(project_id);
    serde_json::to_string(&response).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn load_design_state(
    db_state: State<'_, DatabaseState>,
    memory_state: State<'_, std::sync::Arc<MapState>>,
    project_id: i64,
) -> Result<tauri::ipc::Response, String> {
    // V5.1 Optimization: Prioritize interactive hydration over background tasks.
    // Fetch-add immediately signals other tasks (like indexing) to stop or yield.
    let current_task_id = db_state
        .indexing_task_id
        .fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst) + 1;

    let db_conn_arc = Arc::clone(&db_state.conn);
    let active_id_arc = Arc::clone(&db_state.active_project_id);
    let hydrated_id_arc = Arc::clone(&db_state.hydrated_project_id);
    let indexing_id_arc = Arc::clone(&db_state.indexing_task_id);
    let mem_arc = memory_state.inner().clone();

    let res_blob = tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
        let t_start = std::time::Instant::now();
        
        // 1. Fast Path: Check in-memory sync WITHOUT holding the heavy DB lock
        {
            let active_project_id = *active_id_arc.lock().unwrap();
            let hydrated_project_id = *hydrated_id_arc.lock().unwrap();

            if active_project_id == Some(project_id) && hydrated_project_id == Some(project_id) {
                println!(
                    "[Backend] [Timeline] âš¡ Reusing in-memory state for project {} (Fast path).",
                    project_id
                );
                let snap = mem_arc.to_snapshot();
                return bincode::serialize(&snap).map_err(|e| e.to_string());
            }
        }

        // 2. Resolve target ID logic
        let target_id = {
            let active_id = *active_id_arc.lock().unwrap();
            if let Some(active_id) = active_id {
                if active_id != project_id {
                    println!("[Backend] [V5.1] âš ï¸ Project ID Mismatch: Favoring Active Project {} over requested {}.", active_id, project_id);
                    active_id
                } else {
                    project_id
                }
            } else {
                // Sáº¿p nÃ³i: "Má»›i má»Ÿ app Ä‘Ã£ bá»‹ timeout" -> CÃ³ thá»ƒ load_pmp_file chÆ°a ká»‹p set active_id
                println!("[Backend] [V5.1] âŒ No active project record found. Trying project_id: {}.", project_id);
                project_id
            }
        };

        // 3. Data Fetching (Hold Lock only for DB access)
        let data = {
            let mut retry_count = 0;
            let guard = loop {
                match db_conn_arc.try_lock() {
                    Ok(g) => {
                        // CRITICAL: Double check cancellation status IMMEDIATELY after getting lock
                        if indexing_id_arc.load(Ordering::SeqCst) != current_task_id {
                            println!("[Backend] [Timeline] ðŸ›‘ Task ID mismatch (Cancelled) immediately after acquiring lock for project {}. Yielding.", project_id);
                            return Err("CANCELLED".to_string());
                        }
                        break g;
                    },
                    Err(_) => {
                        retry_count += 1;
                        if retry_count > 100 { // Max 5 seconds (100 * 50ms)
                            return Err("CÆ¡ sá»Ÿ dá»¯ liá»‡u báº­n. Vui lÃ²ng thá»­ láº¡i.".to_string());
                        }
                        // Check if we were cancelled while waiting
                        if indexing_id_arc.load(Ordering::SeqCst) != current_task_id {
                            return Err("CANCELLED".to_string());
                        }
                        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(50));
                    }
                }
            };
            println!("[Backend] [Timeline] ðŸ—ï¸ DB lock acquired for project {} after {:?} (Retry: {})", project_id, t_start.elapsed(), retry_count);

            let conn = guard.as_ref().ok_or("Dá»± Ã¡n chÆ°a Ä‘Æ°á»£c má»Ÿ (No project opened)")?;
            let t_fetch = std::time::Instant::now();
            let checker = Some((indexing_id_arc, current_task_id));
            let res = fetch_project_state_data(conn, target_id, checker);
            println!("[Backend] [Timeline] ðŸ“‚ DB fetch completed in {:?}", t_fetch.elapsed());
            res
        }?;

        // 4. State Reconstruction (OUTSIDE DB Lock)
        // Check if another thread already finished while we were fetching
        {
            let mut hydrated_guard = hydrated_id_arc.lock().unwrap();
            if *hydrated_guard == Some(target_id) && !data.events.is_empty() {
                 println!("[Backend] [Timeline] âš¡ State already hydrated by another thread. Skipping apply.");
            } else {
                let t_apply = std::time::Instant::now();
                apply_project_state_data(&mem_arc, data)?;
                println!("[Backend] [Timeline] ðŸ§  State reconstruction completed in {:?}", t_apply.elapsed());
                *hydrated_guard = Some(target_id);
            }
        }
        
        // 5. Serialization
        let t_serialize = std::time::Instant::now();
        let snap = mem_arc.to_snapshot();
        let result = bincode::serialize(&snap).map_err(|e| e.to_string());
        println!("[Backend] [Timeline] ðŸ“¦ Serialization completed in {:?}", t_serialize.elapsed());
        println!("[Backend] [Timeline] âœ… Total hydration (Cold start) for ID {} took {:?}", target_id, t_start.elapsed());
        
        result
    })
    .await
    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())??;

    // Return raw binary blob
    Ok(tauri::ipc::Response::new(res_blob))
}


#[tauri::command]
pub async fn undo_design_event(
    db_state: State<'_, DatabaseState>,
    memory_state: State<'_, std::sync::Arc<MapState>>,
    project_id: i64,
) -> Result<tauri::ipc::Response, String> {
    let db_conn_arc = Arc::clone(&db_state.conn);
    let mem_arc = memory_state.inner().clone();

    let res_blob = tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
        let guard = db_conn_arc.lock().unwrap();
        let conn = guard.as_ref().ok_or("No project opened")?;

        let _res = undo_project_event(conn, project_id, &mem_arc)?;
        let snap = mem_arc.to_snapshot();
        bincode::serialize(&snap).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
    })
    .await
    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())??;

    *db_state.design_state_blob.lock().unwrap() = Some(res_blob.clone());
    
    Ok(tauri::ipc::Response::new(res_blob))
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn deduplicate_project_data(
    db_state: State<'_, DatabaseState>,
    memory_state: State<'_, std::sync::Arc<MapState>>,
    project_id: i64,
) -> Result<tauri::ipc::Response, String> {
    let guard = db_state.conn.lock().unwrap();
    let conn = guard.as_ref().ok_or("No project opened")?;

    // 1. Identify all deleted feature IDs to purge their creation events (Zombie Purge)
    let mut stmt_del = conn.prepare("SELECT payload_json FROM design_events WHERE project_id = ?1 AND event_type = 'FeatureDeleted' AND is_undone = 0").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let del_rows = stmt_del
        .query_map(rusqlite::params![project_id], |row| {
            Ok(row.get::<_, String>(0)?)
        })
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

    let mut deleted_feature_ids = HashSet::new();
    for res in del_rows {
        let json_str = res.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        if let Ok(DesignEventType::FeatureDeleted { id }) =
            serde_json::from_str::<DesignEventType>(&json_str)
        {
            deleted_feature_ids.insert(id);
        }
    }

    let mut stmt = conn.prepare("SELECT event_id, payload_json FROM design_events WHERE project_id = ?1 AND event_type = 'FeatureCreated' AND is_undone = 0 ORDER BY timestamp ASC").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let rows = stmt
        .query_map(rusqlite::params![project_id], |row| {
            Ok((row.get::<_, String>(0)?, row.get::<_, String>(1)?))
        })
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

    let mut seen_active_keys = HashSet::new();
    let mut to_undo = Vec::new();

    for res in rows {
        let (event_id, payload_json) = res.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        if let Ok(ev) = serde_json::from_str::<DesignEventType>(&payload_json) {
            if let DesignEventType::FeatureCreated {
                id,
                name,
                geom_type,
                coordinates,
                properties,
                ..
            } = ev
            {
                if deleted_feature_ids.contains(&id) {
                    to_undo.push(event_id);
                    continue;
                }
                let norm_coords = if let Some(s) = coordinates.as_str() {
                    serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(s).unwrap_or(coordinates.clone())
                } else {
                    coordinates.clone()
                };
                let norm_props = if let Some(s) = properties.as_str() {
                    serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(s).unwrap_or(properties.clone())
                } else {
                    properties.clone()
                };
                let key = format!(
                    "{}|{}|{}|{}",
                    name,
                    geom_type,
                    serde_json::to_string(&norm_coords).unwrap_or_default(),
                    serde_json::to_string(&norm_props).unwrap_or_default()
                );

                if seen_active_keys.contains(&key) {
                    to_undo.push(event_id);
                } else {
                    seen_active_keys.insert(key);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if to_undo.is_empty() {
        return Err("No duplicates found".to_string());
    }

    let _ = conn.execute("BEGIN TRANSACTION", []);
    for event_id in &to_undo {
        if let Err(e) = conn.execute(
            "UPDATE design_events SET is_undone = 1 WHERE event_id = ?",
            [event_id],
        ) {
            let _ = conn.execute("ROLLBACK", []);
            return Err(e.to_string());
        }
    }
    let _ = conn.execute(
        "DELETE FROM design_snapshots WHERE project_id = ?",
        [project_id],
    );
    let _ = conn.execute("COMMIT", []);

    let snap = memory_state.to_snapshot();
    let blob = bincode::serialize(&snap).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    
    *db_state.design_state_blob.lock().unwrap() = Some(blob.clone());
    *db_state.hydrated_project_id.lock().unwrap() = Some(project_id);

    Ok(tauri::ipc::Response::new(blob))
}

fn json_to_geo_poly(val: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<geo::Polygon<f64>> {
    let rings = val.as_array()?;
    let mut geo_rings = Vec::new();
    for ring in rings {
        let pts = ring.as_array()?;
        let coords: Vec<geo::Coord<f64>> = pts
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|p| {
                let a = p.as_array()?;
                Some(geo::Coord {
                    x: a[0].as_f64()?,
                    y: a[1].as_f64()?,
                })
            })
            .collect();
        if coords.len() >= 3 {
            geo_rings.push(geo::LineString::new(coords));
        }
    }
    if geo_rings.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    let exterior = geo_rings.remove(0);
    Some(geo::Polygon::new(exterior, geo_rings))
}

fn json_to_geo_line(val: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<geo::LineString<f64>> {
    let pts = val.as_array()?;
    let coords: Vec<geo::Coord<f64>> = pts
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|p| {
            let a = p.as_array()?;
            Some(geo::Coord {
                x: a[0].as_f64()?,
                y: a[1].as_f64()?,
            })
        })
        .collect();
    if coords.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    Some(geo::LineString::new(coords))
}

pub fn apply_segmentation(
    feature: &mut FeatureState,
    area_polygons: &Vec<(geo::Polygon<f64>, String)>,
) {
    if feature.geom_type.to_lowercase() != "linestring"
        && feature.geom_type.to_lowercase() != "polyline"
    {
        return;
    }

    let line = match json_to_geo_line(&feature.coordinates) {
        Some(l) => l,
        None => return,
    };

    let epsilon = 0.0001;
    let simplified_line = line.simplify(&epsilon);

    // Safety check: if simplification results in < 2 points, fallback to original line
    let coords = if simplified_line.0.len() < 2 {
        line.0
    } else {
        simplified_line.0
    };

    let mut segments = Vec::new();

    for i in 0..coords.len() - 1 {
        let p1 = coords[i];
        let p2 = coords[i + 1];
        let mid = geo::Coord {
            x: (p1.x + p2.x) / 2.0,
            y: (p1.y + p2.y) / 2.0,
        };

        let mut found_type = "Unknown".to_string();
        for (poly, a_type) in area_polygons.iter() {
            if poly.intersects(&mid) {
                found_type = a_type.clone();
                break;
            }
        }

        segments.push(serde_json::json!({
            "id": uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            "points": [[p1.x, p1.y], [p2.x, p2.y]],
            "segment_type": found_type,
            "properties": {}
        }));
    }

    if let serde_json::Value::Object(ref mut props) = feature.properties {
        props.insert("segments".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Array(segments));
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use serde_json::json;

    #[test]
    fn test_apply_segmentation_simple() {
        let mut feature = FeatureState {
            id: "test".to_string(),
            layer_id: "layer_1".to_string(),
            group_id: Some("group".to_string()),
            name: "test feature".to_string(),
            geom_type: "LineString".to_string(),
            coordinates: json!([[0.0, 0.0], [1.0, 1.0]]),
            properties: json!({}),
            metadata: "{}".to_string(),
        };

        let area_polygons = vec![(
            geo::Polygon::new(
                geo::LineString::from(vec![
                    (0.0, 0.0),
                    (1.0, 0.0),
                    (1.0, 1.0),
                    (0.0, 1.0),
                    (0.0, 0.0),
                ]),
                vec![],
            ),
            "Road".to_string(),
        )];

        apply_segmentation(&mut feature, &area_polygons);

        let segments = feature
            .properties
            .get("segments")
            .unwrap()
            .as_array()
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(segments.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(segments[0]["segment_type"], "Road");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_apply_segmentation_with_simplification() {
        // High frequency zig-zag that should be simplified
        let mut feature = FeatureState {
            id: "test".to_string(),
            layer_id: "layer_1".to_string(),
            group_id: Some("group".to_string()),
            name: "test feature".to_string(),
            geom_type: "LineString".to_string(),
            coordinates: json!([[0.0, 0.0], [0.0000001, 0.0000001], [1.0, 1.0]]),
            properties: json!({}),
            metadata: "{}".to_string(),
        };

        let area_polygons = vec![];
        apply_segmentation(&mut feature, &area_polygons);

        let segments = feature
            .properties
            .get("segments")
            .unwrap()
            .as_array()
            .unwrap();
        // With epsilon 0.0001, the middle point should be removed
        assert_eq!(segments.len(), 1);
    }
}

use crate::design_events::models::FeatureState;
use crate::geometry::types::{Point as GPoint, Segment as GSegment};
use rstar::{PointDistance, RTreeObject, AABB};

/// A wrapper for FeatureState to be used in the R-Tree spatial index.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct SpatialFeature {
    pub id: String,
    pub envelope: AABB<[f64; 2]>,
}

impl RTreeObject for SpatialFeature {
    type Envelope = AABB<[f64; 2]>;
    fn envelope(&self) -> Self::Envelope {
        self.envelope
    }
}

impl PartialEq for SpatialFeature {
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        self.id == other.id
    }
}

impl SpatialFeature {
    pub fn from_feature(feature: &FeatureState) -> Option<Self> {
        let coords = &feature.coordinates;
        let geom_type = feature.geom_type.to_lowercase();

        let epsilon = 1e-9;

        // 1. Try standard geom_type matching
        if geom_type == "point" {
            if let Some(arr) = coords.as_array() {
                if arr.len() >= 2 {
                    let x = arr[0].as_f64()?;
                    let y = arr[1].as_f64()?;
                    return Some(Self {
                        id: feature.id.clone(),
                        envelope: AABB::from_corners(
                            [x - epsilon, y - epsilon],
                            [x + epsilon, y + epsilon],
                        ),
                    });
                }
            }
        } else if geom_type == "linestring" || geom_type == "polyline" {
            if let Some(arr) = coords.as_array() {
                let mut min_x = f64::MAX;
                let mut max_x = f64::MIN;
                let mut min_y = f64::MAX;
                let mut max_y = f64::MIN;
                let mut count = 0;
                for p in arr {
                    if let Some(c) = p.as_array() {
                        if c.len() >= 2 {
                            let x = c[0].as_f64()?;
                            let y = c[1].as_f64()?;
                            min_x = min_x.min(x);
                            max_x = max_x.max(x);
                            min_y = min_y.min(y);
                            max_y = max_y.max(y);
                            count += 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if count > 0 {
                    return Some(Self {
                        id: feature.id.clone(),
                        envelope: AABB::from_corners(
                            [min_x - epsilon, min_y - epsilon],
                            [max_x + epsilon, max_y + epsilon],
                        ),
                    });
                }
            }
        } else if geom_type == "polygon" {
            if let Some(rings) = coords.as_array() {
                let mut min_x = f64::MAX;
                let mut max_x = f64::MIN;
                let mut min_y = f64::MAX;
                let mut max_y = f64::MIN;
                let mut count = 0;
                for ring in rings {
                    if let Some(arr) = ring.as_array() {
                        for p in arr {
                            if let Some(c) = p.as_array() {
                                if c.len() >= 2 {
                                    let x = c[0].as_f64()?;
                                    let y = c[1].as_f64()?;
                                    min_x = min_x.min(x);
                                    max_x = max_x.max(x);
                                    min_y = min_y.min(y);
                                    max_y = max_y.max(y);
                                    count += 1;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if count > 0 {
                    return Some(Self {
                        id: feature.id.clone(),
                        envelope: AABB::from_corners([min_x, min_y], [max_x, max_y]),
                    });
                }
            }
        } else if geom_type == "rect" {
            if let Some(obj) = coords.as_object() {
                let x = obj.get("x")?.as_f64()?;
                let y = obj.get("y")?.as_f64()?;
                let width = obj.get("width")?.as_f64()?;
                let height = obj.get("height")?.as_f64()?;
                return Some(Self {
                    id: feature.id.clone(),
                    envelope: AABB::from_corners([x, y], [x + width, y + height]),
                });
            }
        }

        // 2. Inference: If geom_type is custom (e.g., "Camera"), detect from coordinates array structure
        if let Some(arr) = coords.as_array() {
            if arr.len() == 2 && arr[0].is_number() && arr[1].is_number() {
                // Looks like a point [lng, lat]
                let x = arr[0].as_f64()?;
                let y = arr[1].as_f64()?;
                return Some(Self {
                    id: feature.id.clone(),
                    envelope: AABB::from_corners(
                        [x - epsilon, y - epsilon],
                        [x + epsilon, y + epsilon],
                    ),
                });
            } else if arr.len() > 0 && arr[0].is_array() {
                // Looks like a polyline or polygon [[lng, lat], ...] or [[[lng, lat], ...]]
                // For spatial indexing envelope, we can just flatten and find min/max
                let mut min_x = f64::MAX;
                let mut max_x = f64::MIN;
                let mut min_y = f64::MAX;
                let mut max_y = f64::MIN;
                let mut found = false;

                fn find_bounds(
                    val: &serde_json::Value,
                    min_x: &mut f64,
                    max_x: &mut f64,
                    min_y: &mut f64,
                    max_y: &mut f64,
                    found: &mut bool,
                ) {
                    if let Some(arr) = val.as_array() {
                        if arr.len() >= 2 && arr[0].is_number() && arr[1].is_number() {
                            let x = arr[0].as_f64().unwrap_or(0.0);
                            let y = arr[1].as_f64().unwrap_or(0.0);
                            *min_x = min_x.min(x);
                            *max_x = max_x.max(x);
                            *min_y = min_y.min(y);
                            *max_y = max_y.max(y);
                            *found = true;
                        } else {
                            for item in arr {
                                find_bounds(item, min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y, found);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                find_bounds(
                    coords, &mut min_x, &mut max_x, &mut min_y, &mut max_y, &mut found,
                );

                if found {
                    return Some(Self {
                        id: feature.id.clone(),
                        envelope: AABB::from_corners(
                            [min_x - epsilon, min_y - epsilon],
                            [max_x + epsilon, max_y + epsilon],
                        ),
                    });
                }
            }
        }

        None
    }
}

/// A wrapper for LineString segments to be used in a separate R-Tree.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct SpatialSegment {
    pub feature_id: String,
    pub segment: GSegment,
    pub envelope: AABB<[f64; 2]>,
}

impl RTreeObject for SpatialSegment {
    type Envelope = AABB<[f64; 2]>;
    fn envelope(&self) -> Self::Envelope {
        self.envelope
    }
}

impl PointDistance for SpatialSegment {
    fn distance_2(&self, point: &[f64; 2]) -> f64 {
        let p = GPoint::new(point[0], point[1]);
        // Use existing distance logic
        let d = crate::geometry::snapping::point_segment_distance(p, self.segment);
        d * d
    }
}

impl SpatialSegment {
    pub fn new(feature_id: String, segment: GSegment) -> Self {
        let min_x = segment.start.x.min(segment.end.x);
        let max_x = segment.start.x.max(segment.end.x);
        let min_y = segment.start.y.min(segment.end.y);
        let max_y = segment.start.y.max(segment.end.y);

        let epsilon = 1e-9;
        Self {
            feature_id,
            segment,
            envelope: AABB::from_corners(
                [min_x - epsilon, min_y - epsilon],
                [max_x + epsilon, max_y + epsilon],
            ),
        }
    }
}

use crate::design_events::models::{
    FeatureGroupState, FeatureState, LayerState, RegionState, SerializableFeatureState,

use crate::design_events::spatial::{SpatialFeature, SpatialSegment};
